Peter,

Donald Trump made one of the most outrageous moves of his campaign. His administration is withholding over $6 billion in federal education funding, cutting vital support for students, teachers, and families across the country.

Here in Rhode Island, that means **_a freeze of $30 million, or 17% of our K-12 funding._** That includes cuts to:
* After school and summer programs
* Teacher training and hiring

## Trump Lands Trade Deal with European Union
President Trump announced a [trade agreement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMHK3CAAhJ_G3FyMujE5eNhSPBT-Uuihx2DWcWMxGtRs2Lcv-_cR_tvAwDDf9-dj_rAhhvT4aTfo5vOccNaI1lBmHK1YBwcbQ3qitlxw7GsuM2f8SpmifJydDfE1y85pD3CIDrpXVzFMismxW_Uogek-Lj2DV44NYpmWxUovlJ28F7IL-r3GFB97xiQbLs55K-ywKNbDj5iIZHCh5XL5m0NqK3x85SfK5Z63Luq1tb0ScSPcEG7O87xsNb07wg0SPSrhZssJL8JNbisK4aaVY9tpta9KD1ppgb2vqPQTl9pHATakRs_QVoqj5B3_c3-lzZbgPeHGFnq79T-y-pWJMPkeHBHfv71V4qy_UfauaLefIcZQB0Uke2w2xM_T7Uumn5r_CwAA___V3ZVO) with the European Union after a brief meeting with EU President Ursula von der Leyen on Sunday at the Trump Turnberry Golf Course in Scotland. The deal, which sets a 15% tariff on most goods coming from Europe, closes days before the looming Friday deadline, when Trump promised 30% tariffs. The deal also involves Europe purchasing $150 billion worth of U.S. energy and adding $600 billion in other investments into the U.S. Von der Leyen and Trump addressed the media before their closed-door conversation, saying there was a 50-50 chance of reaching a deal. After it was struck, Trump said, _"I think it's the biggest deal ever made."_ Trump emphasized the need for fairness in the trade deal with its largest trading partner, with von der Leyen agreeing to "[rebalancing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhSAYBeCnwQ2DiKADQxe327WjofJz_RsEg7_a-_aN9xU6n-ScfOfrMT0cRkzPT7eCpZCnBNcegQjKBAcV58GDi5hO2CkXOLYll0kK2XFhuOwn7zC-JlV5GwAktBXYxnStHoxQfbXYDoZWat1J7_rQCaPVAM4oYzpo_Bx0hfZuE0b2jRBK6Nr74Fqnv41oIPQwMCXAI-VS_2RMtECIr3xCqee8VtEuRNvO2g8mRybH67rqkH9vxZ0zOW45IuG8MzlSOdaNu5TykWbY-ZvHbx-Ho-QNXOJHwpyqYv12YYy4a8OUeK4O43uP_nXSaeVfAAAA__8AfX5I)" what Trump called a "one-sided" trade relationship.
## 11 Injured in Michigan Walmart Knife Attack
Michigan officials are seeking to [file terrorism charges against a man](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ8GOqLxD9gULm6TLrfdEo3xGGZlMDJOorz9in2FLY-OdI6-7-sxPZAT78t_3MjVmKed3meiWqlM9KwFAwXCxPuLzpoLPY81l0mC7DswnbRTQE6fSbfBRSJJqiUnTK-G0YC27epAjb1HGsbBetvLGMMM3ppgRBSggmzZXWtgpBUAGoZbCBEVDt6AoGhpbDRQ4JrL7TvzXleK6ZNfVG5z3trk1lqPs1H_Gnlv5B2PC-CqrlAqz4kaeX9j2rDU7qzoPe9Lt_G88oJ7p7SIXugo_GxEL7XyylhAFQyhDwhtceF4c0p8DqbRsGzI6fe6_snXy8mfAAAA__8trn7S) who allegedly stabbed 11 people at a Walmart in Traverse City on Saturday. The suspect, Bradford James Gille, 42, began attacking shoppers with a [folding pocket knife](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuhTAURFdjOiP_-LzCRaSI7qWJopTogi_gyGBkX3hi9xHZQqopRhrNOd_P_gk--G3-gBUtTbHf8JUDEmHq8aAEDh1C8NuJmWLCY19i6pVQFRcNV23vwIerN4WzE6JCXaCVTaXrRyNMWyx2eDgQALVWTo3OSAcajR5A17qRbsTC23tNNKqVQhhRl85NoKEeGiFxavHBjEDnKabyJ_qNFpzCFU9M5RjXItiFaM9MvzHVMdXBMN4E5Rzvmqnu65Opbj0C-T0g3zHekQmGAR1_QVghEacEJ6aMfPR08dWPi59h4_nIO47EVHezX0x33jH9LpWRopJtVSTr9pcPwee6YUbMK_jwd4v-5fK06jcAAP__QXmKww) near the checkout counter before making his way to the store parking lot, where bystanders, including one person with a gun, subdued him. As of Sunday afternoon, two of the victims remained in serious condition. One had been released from the hospital, and the others were listed in fair condition. Authorities believe the victims, one of whom is a Walmart employee, were not specifically targeted. Grand Traverse Sheriff Mike Shea indicated the suspect has a [criminal history](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAURL_G7rAwJgYXFNuky7ZbWpdwsUmwseA6KH-_8vuF145Goznn32N-QIhhX_7ChoZ8mnesJSIR5hlPyuDQIcSwf7BQyngea8qz4OLGuGJCzw5C_M6ydcYjChxaNL26DeOkuNTtaiaUoCYhxaS1smIaJsf1U3ltB9mPcmyDuda4ErrnXPKxc87DAKNVvEevcWokRxco5e6Vwk4r-vhNH8zdM21tNCvRUZrhTyPujbjXWrsLoSK-r8IVrYnZDM6n7NgLNixsCTHil9UViFVk7z1VBjadxCrEDTKxQmBt2BdWznLgk5jouVRat9m4o4YYQxlVI_myQYg_T-hX-j5G_A8AAP__bhqGQg).
## List: Countries That Pray Most
People in the developing world [pray more](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2uozAURlcDnZH_gknhYhq6TDslcuzr-I4MRvYFlFn9KO8t4bWfPp0jnT-P5eEw4_b67VawFMuywdUyEEFd4KDqAgRwGbcTGpUKx55KXSSXN8YNk9MSHOb3ovtgI4AE1YMV5qbGu-F66pMVXkQVJ670zcvAn8KoEMxdq9FrZ4Lo0X5o3MhJcK75OIQQnXLj03ABcYJ7pzkEpFKHvwU3ShDzu5xQB1_WPttEtLdO_erk3Mn5uq7hxHa47N2O5DI2-hw7OX_P-A8CuxL6xHw5NqoIje3VvRklYGtp1Mm5rzbsF-aMbTSd5q_VYf7y0Y8inVb-DwAA__83zX5l) than their Western counterparts, according to a new study, identifying the countries where daily prayer is most common. Indonesia tops the list, with 269 million people, 95% of the population, saying they pray at least daily. Kenya and Nigeria round out the top three, with 84% of their respective populations praying daily. Among Western nations, the U.S. stands out as the top praying country, with nearly 150 million people and 44% of the population praying daily, while India posted the highest absolute number, with an estimated 1 billion people practicing daily prayer. The study uses data from 35 countries, excluding countries like China, where data was unavailable. The [full list is available](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2uozAURlcDnZH_gknhYhq6TDslcuzr-I4MRvYFlFn9KO8t4bWfPp0jnT-P5eEw4_b67VawFMuywdUyEEFd4KDqAgRwGbcTGpUKx55KXSSXN8YNk9MSHOb3ovtgI4AE1YMV5qbGu-F66pMVXkQVJ670zcvAn8KoEMxdq9FrZ4Lo0X5o3MhJcK75OIQQnXLj03ABcYJ7pzkEpFKHvwU3ShDzu5xQB1_WPttEtLdO_erk3Mn5uq7hxHa47N2O5DI2-hw7OX_P-A8CuxL6xHw5NqoIje3VvRklYGtp1Mm5rzbsF-aMbTSd5q_VYf7y0Y8inVb-DwAA__83zX5l)[ here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2uozAURlcDnZH_gknhYhq6TDslcuzr-I4MRvYFlFn9KO8t4bWfPp0jnT-P5eEw4_b67VawFMuywdUyEEFd4KDqAgRwGbcTGpUKx55KXSSXN8YNk9MSHOb3ovtgI4AE1YMV5qbGu-F66pMVXkQVJ670zcvAn8KoEMxdq9FrZ4Lo0X5o3MhJcK75OIQQnXLj03ABcYJ7pzkEpFKHvwU3ShDzu5xQB1_WPttEtLdO_erk3Mn5uq7hxHa47N2O5DI2-hw7OX_P-A8CuxL6xHw5NqoIje3VvRklYGtp1Mm5rzbsF-aMbTSd5q_VYf7y0Y8inVb-DwAA__83zX5l).

## Austin Explores New Air Traffic Controller Program
Austin is exploring the possibility of establishing a local air traffic controller academy to [address an urgent staffing crisis](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp8GOkfG4B8Kim3o7rZborE9JqN1cGRPws3br7ivsPWRzqfz_fnavoAyHftveODC36lsB54tIzPWzb8CYvPYGHago2KkxpUCb0oqLaQVym0RKH-2qY-Ll3EeelwGq0crpTZTf1_k4KwZnAsJJXrnMEgfvE9TBDujcj0tl0xa5YZBqkndtEvSDC7EcXYz6rGbJEbiUm98R8ZvaCl_yhvrLZRHn5c787N1469OrZ1az_O8_X2_8IKdWqEyhYydWq-uTq25BMgXeDWmQwTijwjldQTKAqgKrpASBRHKwbVk8axlr_AQP8Oi8UWPXbR7qQw7XkplZqENjDb5KACsERNqLXxMRsg4jFKPozUe-7rE50k5UzO2m-T-AMo_Efx_178X9S8AAP__0weZBQ) at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS). Currently, only 29 of 60 positions for certified controllers at AUS are filled, causing travel delays and raising safety concerns. The city has proposed partnering with Austin Community College (ACC) and the FAA to create an air traffic controller training program. "Hey, I lost my job unexpectedly last week."
An old friend told me this over the phone. He's a very smart, competent executive - the kind of person I would actually ask for professional advice or send someone else to for guidance. I never would have imagined him having to face losing his job. He didn't even go to a Coldplay concert.
He's not the only one I've heard this from. A classmate of mine lost his job at a tech company and has been doing random project work for months, some of which is unpaid. Another was laid off by a bank and has been interviewing with startups but is expecting a much lower salary. Another hasn't lost his job but there's a hiring freeze at his organization and he's expecting his compensation to flatline even including cost-of-living adjustments.
It's become something of a pattern among my network. Part of this might be that I'm a Gen X-er, and when you're in your late 40s or early 50s, careers can turn kind of quickly. Part of it is that some of these people work in technology and media, which are industries that are going through rising layoffs. Part of it is AI, which is right now being utilized more and more by various companies. One founder said to me, "We're not firing people, but we're also not hiring people we otherwise would have hired if AI wasn't doing a lot of the work we used to have entry-level people do." A person never hired may as well be as good as a layoff for that individual, though they'll never know it. A professor at a prestigious University told me that for the first time he has former students calling him saying they can't find a job and they're driving Ubers for a living.
I was on CNBC [recently](https://substack.com/redirect/ca3271b3-335b-4c3e-b8b6-0b8d2a2064dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) talking about this latest trend. Dario Amodei, CE of AI company Anthropic [projected](https://substack.com/redirect/2b920e65-a834-4d1b-a6b2-31626c078f73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that AI could replace half of all entry-level white collar jobs in the next 5 years, causing unemployment to surge. I'm sure he's right. And it's not just white-collar jobs. I recently rode in a Waymo robot taxi in Los Angeles and the experience was very impressive. Would I choose it over an Uber driver? Yes, I would. It was more peaceful and less stressful, even if the Waymo's ultra-cautious driving made the trip 2 minutes longer. You get to play your own music instead of listening to the driver's, and you could be obnoxious or take calls because you're alone. Also, in this case the Waymo was 25% cheaper. I said, "Thank you" to no one in particular when I got out of the car out of habit. I've used Waymo several times since last week.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0373b29a-74cb-4bdb-b507-8779028a1fdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Driving a car or truck is the most common job in 29 states. I'm sure Waymo is already putting a dent in the frequency of Uber requests in Phoenix, San Francisco, Austin, Atlanta and LA where it's currently operating. They're expanding soon to Miami and D.C.
This is all happening in a country where [60%](https://substack.com/redirect/b5526c3b-4adf-48ae-a183-78d68b8568c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Americans already can't afford a decent standard of living. So . . . if drivers, entry-level workers, and experienced executives aren't faring well, who is?
That's really the question. Too much of our information is conveyed through either media networks that typically cheerlead for ongoing efficiencies or influencers who may be anomalies in the marketplace; they may enjoy superstar economics (there are always a few winners in every field, even a diminished one) or be subject to a constant incentive to adopt a veneer of success; who the hell wants to listen to someone who is struggling to make ends meet? That's for real life, not the fake one I want to see online or on TV.
So how does one figure out what's actually going on? Of course, you start with your own life; odds are your costs are creeping up. If you're stressed, then it's certain that others are too. Check in with the people around you and listen. Express some vulnerability and you'll often hear it reciprocated. I occasionally turn to stats like credit card [delinquencies](https://substack.com/redirect/b96763c7-aeb4-4a1c-8b30-dda7f61c8cc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which are pushing record highs. 20% of job-seekers have been [searching](https://substack.com/redirect/91eb8ba0-a349-4d82-9d50-1e6afb008703?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for at least 10 months.
Trust me when I say there's a lot of struggling going on underneath the surface. And the water level is rising in unexpected ways, capsizing people one wouldn't expect. Just about everyone has a fight they're engaged in.
If you're doing well, appreciate it and take advantage of it! Maybe squirrel some earnings away for a rainy day. Times can change quickly and you don't want to be unprepared. If you can give to the needy, by all means do so.
If you're struggling, please know that you're not alone. We will be looking for ways to help, which I know sounds far-fetched but is sincere.
On a personal note, thank you for following me and subscribing to this email list/ Substack. Someone said to me, "Hey Andrew, you can't be fired unless you decide to fire yourself!" That's not quite right, but in my case I'm very grateful for those who help make this work possible. Thank you.
Enjoy the summer and appreciate what you've got! There's a lot of hardship hiding in plain sight out there.
To see what Forward is doing, including our 3rd birthday party, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/fac21cb7-4d84-43e9-9ac0-1d1b3687a7f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). | Friends-
National Support Public Education Day is in TWO DAYS! Here at Freedom Virginia, we love public education; we believe that everyone deserves access to a quality education. However, we couldn't have the amazing public education we have in Virginia without the dedicated teachers, staff, and administrators who teach, support, and love our students.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112254108/559929541/-1743631236?refcode=ea.0e75a29c-b16b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.0e75a29c-b16b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTc1YTI5Yy1iMTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1BxTsbMNpBvwIEPR8HWR6cNk5NVrhrmB73_4eYObMDY=) Hello, Peter, **I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. It isn’t a secret... our plan for success is simple, and the ball is already rolling.
I’m Josh Weil, U.S. Senate candidate and proud father, public school teacher, Floridian, American. I’m cooking up a recipe for a big win in 2026, and I need your help to pull it off.
The best part? It starts with something this simple:
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/5A4C475A515679424F4346462F3847644E4E47495A624634595A49632B7A59466C696D73414452743237642F5353754A4738622B304A484F32764174312B4C5A/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-07-28%20at%207.42.30%E2%80%AFAM.png]
We didn’t talk about polls. We didn’t talk about political strategy.
We talked about rent. Insurance. Groceries. About how it feels to work hard and still fall behind because the people in power have forgotten what it’s like to live like the rest of us. It all started with a hello, a smile, and a handshake.
Ashley Moody doesn’t understand that struggle, she doesn’t want to, and she certainly won’t extend a hand to those who need it most. She was appointed, not elected, and now she’s endorsed by Trump to keep rubber-stamping his cruel and corrupt agenda.
Friend, We’re doing things differently.
This campaign is about showing up, listening, and building trust one conversation at a time to make living affordable. But we can’t keep it going without your support.

The [Eastern Pacific basin](https://substack.com/redirect/f854e51c-7daf-4a27-be39-8a43d5502c60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is lit up right now with four active systems -- one of which is Tropical Storm (soon to be Hurricane) Iona. As we enter August, we expect to see a dramatic increase in development in the Atlantic Basin, as well.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3eddf282-037b-4bf5-82d9-311d325d8100?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Several minor systems are also active in the Northwest Pacific basin, with a potential tropical storm impact on China later this week.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/497cdfc4-aac1-4fde-a1df-db264e1f42d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On a more personal note, I was reminded today that we are nearing the 20th anniversary of Hurricane Katrina.
I grew up on the Mississippi Gulf Coast, and was 16 when Katrina hit. In the two decades since, I have studied and worked toward preventing another catastrophe like the one I survived.
With all that education and experience, I take no joy in saying we are woefully unprepared for another storm like Katrina.
And with our federal government in shambles, I fear that if Katrina had hit today, the death toll would be much higher.

| | [ **TAKE THE SURVEY** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Dear Fellow Conservative, You know it and I know it—Congress is broken. There are politicians who have turned “serving the people” into “serving themselves.” They use their positions to get richer and richer every year, while you and I get left behind. As if it wasn't hard enough to fix anything in Washington, D.C.! But every week President Trump proves that we don’t have to accept the status quo: the demolition of Iran’s nuclear capabilities, NATO upping their contributions, the downsizing of Big Government agencies, etc... If there was ever a chance for big change – it’s now. **[That’s why we’re spearheading an immediate and nationwide canvassing of American patriots called the “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY.”](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **
---
[ **TAKE THE SURVEY** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Today, WE THE PEOPLE, have our best chance to break the career politician’s hold on Congress. But we need to know _if_ you support term limits and _how_ you want to get it done -- and we have to act fast. **[That’s why we need your completed “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY” right away.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Our Founding Fathers never intended for government service to be a permanent career. George Washington famously served just two terms as President—then went home. But our Founding Fathers also said our government was made for a “moral and religious people.” And they understood that if that moral compass broke down, Congress could easily steer America in the wrong direction, become a do-nothing body, or make government a gravy train for themselves. That’s why they included a powerful safeguard in our Constitution -- an escape hatch -- enshrined in Article V. If Congress ever became too corrupt to fix itself, Article V. says the states can act. 34 states can call a convention, propose an amendment -- like the one being proposed on term limits -- and Congress can’t do a thing about it. **[We have led the term limits movement in the past, and are ready to put our efforts behind the movement once again. But we need to know where _you_ stand on the issue first.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **
---
[ **TAKE THE SURVEY** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Every one of our initiatives for America is led by you – patriots aged 50+. We are AMAC Action. “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of Americans, “action” is what we’re known for. President Trump has said that AMAC Action is so effective that members of Congress run the other way when they see our delegates coming down the hall. Washington lifers will certainly be on the run if you tell us you support term limits! **[That’s why we need your completed “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY” today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Do you agree...
---
>> No more golden pensions for people who work 170 days a year and spend half of that time just trying to get reelected. >> No more using the power of the office and insider deals to get rich. >> No more jobs for life with nothing to show for it!
---
Tell us right away if you want us to unleash our AMAC Action delegates and tell us your thoughts on Article V.
---
* **Nancy Pelosi — 38 years**
* **Mitch McConnell — 40 years**
* **Maxine Waters — 34 years**
* **Chuck Schumer — 44 years**

---
They’ve been in the swamp so long they’ve grown gills. **[Please – let’s not let them drag America down into the swamp with them. Tell us if it’s time to use the escape hatch our Founders left for us.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) ** Your completed **“TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY”** gives AMAC Action our marching orders PLUS it shows a massive groundswell of support for term limits (if that turns out to be the case) to embolden the 34 states needed. That’s why we’re spearheading this massive nationwide survey and why you got my email today. You’ve proven that you’re a patriot who can be counted on to take action. We couldn’t waste any time on people who prefer complaining to acting. **[Please complete your “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY” right away and submit it along with your sacrificial donation of $10 $25, $50 or more to spread this national campaign across America.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** We need to reach **1 million** patriots with surveys just like the one I’m asking you to fill out. We’re blanketing the country through the mail, email, calls, and reaching patriots in person. All that takes time and money. The Washington lifers are counting on having more power, influence, and resources than the American people. They’re counting on our complacency and despair. But here at AMAC Action, if you agree, we’ll finish the fight our Founders began and restore America’s government to the people! With commands from one million surveys, we’ll know if it’s time to use Article V. to retake the ship. **[Your $25 gift is enough to send and collect 50 more “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEYS.” Your gift of $50 funds 100 more “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEYS”—through every channel: the mail, email, text, online etc!](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) ** You can see that**** singlehandedly, you are an indispensable force multiplier in this effort. But if you do nothing, you let other patriots speak for you. And worse, nothing changes.
---
Immigration policy will never get fixed and just stay a meaningless election year talking point. America’s spending and debt will continue to grow unchecked. Remember when we had a balanced budget? We can get back there if career politicians do something! Social Security will keep getting raided while real policies to protect your benefits sit on the back burner. Healthcare costs will do nothing but skyrocket leaving seniors vulnerable. America’s children will stay trapped in the leftwing indoctrination centers we call “public schools.” And the Washington, D.C. lifers will just get lazier and lazier.
---
But don’t let me decide for you. **[Please complete your “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY” and make the choice for yourself. And please remember that doing nothing is a choice as well.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** One million **“TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEYS”** is a bold goal but we can do it if we all pitch in. Every dollar helps. Every signature counts. Every day matters. Your survey is only 4 questions long – please complete it and respond right away. Thank you and may God bless you and these United States.
---
| | With hope and urgency,
---
**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_** **AMAC Action**
---
| [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

It’s Article V. and if you agree, we can use it to make term limits law. **[Please complete your “TIME FOR TERM LIMITS SURVEY” and submit it along with your emergency gift of $10, $25 $50 or more right away.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** While the Washington lifers are lounging on the Lido deck, we can make history and save America. It’s your choice. Please respond ASAP!

[ **TAKE THE SURVEY** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

| | | *****MEDIA ADVISORY***** **FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY** **DATE:** July 28, 2025 **CONTACT:** Luis Sanchez Armas, [press.enaccion@climatepower.us](mailto:press.enaccion@climatepower.us)

|
### **TUESDAY, JULY 29 AT 12:00 P.M. ET**
**CHC Chair Rep. Adriano Espaillat, Climate Power En Acción,
America’s Voice, and Voto Latino to Dissect Impacts of
Republican Budget Law on Latinos** **WASHINGTON** — On **_Tuesday, July 29, at 12:00 p.m. ET_** , Congressional Hispanic Caucus Chair Adriano Espaillat and leaders of [Climate Power En Acción](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=275dba65fb&e=b8f90417f9), [America’s Voice](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=d1a6c93da4&e=b8f90417f9), and [Voto Latino](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=615c098b20&e=b8f90417f9), will host a virtual bilingual media briefing titled [“Trump’s Summer of Lies.”](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=9e6c2ea8a2&e=b8f90417f9) They will discuss President Trump and Congressional Republicans’ recently passed budget bill and its far-reaching impacts on Latinos.

The conversation will particularly focus on how the new Republican law is a direct attack on Latino families, as it effectively forces them to pay more for energy, makes access to healthcare more difficult and more expensive, eliminates tax credits and jobs in clean energy, provides unprecedented funding for ICE and mass sweeps, and unravels countless environmental protections.

The event will be held in English, but speakers will be available to take questions in Spanish.

**WHAT:** “Trump’s Summer of Lies,” a virtual bilingual press briefing to discuss the impacts on Latinos of the recently adopted Republican budget reconciliation law.

**WHEN:** Tuesday, July 29 at 12:00 p.m. ET

**WHO:**
* **Representative Adriano Espaillat,** New York’s 13th Congressional District
* **Antonieta Cádiz,** Executive Director of Climate Power En Acción
* **Vanessa Cárdenas,** Executive Director of America’s Voice
* **Dennis Gonzalez,** Chief Strategy Officer of Voto Latino

**WHERE:** Virtual — **[Register here](https://solidaritystrategies.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=985fddf6f660c0281e297f819&id=640b3672b4&e=b8f90417f9)** for the briefing and to receive materials ahead of the event. If you have any questions, please contact [press.enaccion@climatepower.us](mailto:press.enaccion@climatepower.us?subject=Trump%E2%80%99s%20Summer%20of%20Lies%20Query).

| Peter,
The walls are closing in on Donald Trump. The active cover-up of his ties to Jeffrey Epstein's pedophilia and human trafficking ring is one of the, if not, the largest political scandals in recent history.
The backlash to this scandal and his administration's fascist agenda should lead to a massive victory for Democrats in the '26 midterms--reclaiming the House, neutering his presidency, and beginning the fall of the Trump era.
But like any villain, Donald Trump has a fallback plan to maintain his grip on power. He is openly signaling he will run for a third term and so far the MAGA controlled Supreme Court has let him do anything that he wants. He is so emboldened that he is even selling Trump 2028 hats on his official store:
---
| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Lwb8DH_ohl45YnDpb74JIMtCZcXCsyxNC5WU8fqoa-JM1TQveduBNB4jwv8djvC-A8QG7Y8FQCtYra6dR13i1o_KDaYXtQ_MWnlOqBa9vfjeEgFC754EivN118BMLVewL0HOb_v5ngAqEcUUKk4wTuAB7PxS4n4IW2IA3tOdw-f4rY6E-eBYASeEtVinGjKumrr8A7-CpEGeosu2kDmmROHBVNaj7LYIGxJGqPB2gLM=&c=jm4iWyHCQgIRCRpPlliCx9wKk_J_Oo7-rX3uOR4IQFrtzX2W_WaAUQ==&ch=YU0-Lis2POowTAAVRViRGHFeLDNAiCmgInPTTizn75svZbnEgyfQUw==)

Right now, the groundwork is being laid to ensure a Trump third term. MAGA operatives are pouring tens of millions into flipping key state Supreme Courts--quietly placing loyalists who will control how elections are decided in swing states critical to winning the presidency.
Trump attempted and failed a state supreme court takeover in Wisconsin earlier this year. But they learned from that defeat. Elon Musk's involvement brought a spotlight, rallying Democrats to stop the takeover. Now, with Musk on the sidelines, Trump's plan is continuing in the dark.
Trump has Pennsylvania's Supreme Court in his crosshairs next, working behind the scenes to defeat three Democrat Supreme Court justices in a rare retention election this November. If Trump takes this court, he will control election laws in the most important swing state in the country--ensuring PA goes red in 2028.

In Mississippi, the roles of tax assessor and tax collector are often merged into one elected position at the county level, known as the Tax Assessor-Collector. This office deals with the assessment and collection of property taxes across the state's 82 counties, a process that imposes financial obligations on residents and businesses to support local budgets, despite the burdens it places on payers.
Candidates obtain the office through countywide elections held every four years, as outlined in Article 5, Section 135 of the Mississippi Constitution. To run, individuals must be county residents, at least 21 years old, and qualified voters, with backgrounds in areas like real estate or administration sometimes proving useful, though not required. Elections occur in November of odd-numbered years, such as 2023 for terms beginning in 2024, and incumbents can seek re-election indefinitely. While no formal certifications are needed for candidacy, elected officials may undergo training from the Mississippi Department of Revenue to handle the job's demands.
As tax assessor, the primary duty involves valuing taxable property, including land, buildings, and personal items like vehicles or equipment. This requires maintaining records, maps, and ownership details to determine assessments based on market or use value, aiming for uniformity under state guidelines. The assessor submits tax rolls to the county Board of Supervisors for approval by July annually. They also process homestead exemption applications--available from January 1 to April 1--which offer limited relief by reducing taxable value for primary homes. Notably, assessors do not set tax rates or budgets; those decisions fall to boards and councils, leaving the assessor to enforce valuations that can lead to higher bills amid rising property values.
In the tax collector capacity, the office manages the gathering of various levies, such as ad valorem taxes on real and personal property, as well as fees for vehicles, manufactured homes, and out-of-state purchases. Delinquent properties face advertisement and sale at annual tax auctions, often in late August, adding pressure on owners at risk of losing assets. Collectors distribute revenues to entities like schools and municipalities, while also issuing vehicle registrations, license plates, and business privilege licenses--tasks that underscore the administrative weight of compliance.
Overall, Mississippi's tax assessor-collectors administer a system that extracts funds for public needs, though it frequently draws criticism for its impact on personal finances and economic pressures. With reliance on voter accountability and periodic training, these officials navigate a framework prone to disputes over fairness and necessity, reflecting the contentious nature of taxation in funding government operations.

"Senator, there's a difference between what you see on paper and what you see in reality!" Dhillon fired back at Schiff.
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/3055f824-b880-44c9-8627-73beb6e2bd7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Schiff cited conservative Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas for supporting "race neutral policies" employed by the University of California.
"Are the race-neutral policies, like those used by the University of California, which Justice Thomas explicitly praised in that opinion, now considered by you to be illegal DEI?" Schiff pressed Dhillon.
"Senator, there's a difference between what you see on paper and what you see in reality!" Dhillon fired back at Schiff. "I reject your premise that how California describes its admissions practices is reality!"

# Thailand and Cambodia agree to ceasefire after Trump calls
Thailand and Cambodia agreed to an immediate ceasefire effective Monday midnight **[after President Trump threatened to withhold trade deals](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab20e8c-0f89-42d2-b5dc-c22b29ff07cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from both countries until the fighting ended, with peace talks organized by Malaysian and American officials in Putrajaya, Malaysia.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab20e8c-0f89-42d2-b5dc-c22b29ff07cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The conflict erupted last Thursday over a disputed border temple** , marking the deadliest fighting between the two Southeast Asian nations in nearly 15 years, with 36 people killed and hundreds of thousands of civilians forced to flee their homes.
* **Trump's intervention proved decisive in ending the violence** , with the president speaking directly to both leaders on Saturday and later telling reporters "we ended the war" and prevented what "could've gone on for years" with "millions of people" potentially killed.
* **The ceasefire came as Trump prepares worldwide tariffs on August 1** , with both countries eager to secure favorable trade deals given Thailand's $63.3 billion in annual exports to the U.S., while China also pressured both nations for peace due to its significant economic interests in the region.

* * *
# Good guy with a gun: Marine veteran confronts knife-wielding maniac at Walmart
Marine veteran Derrick Perry **[confronted a knife-wielding attacker](https://substack.com/redirect/26f534ce-7b90-44cf-addb-749ec26ae7fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who stabbed 11 people at a Walmart in Traverse City, Michigan, using his handgun to force the suspect to drop his weapon in the parking lot while other customers helped subdue him.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/26f534ce-7b90-44cf-addb-749ec26ae7fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The suspect, Bradford James Gille, 42, faces terrorism charges and 11 counts of assault with intent to murder** after going on a random stabbing spree that began just before 5 p.m. Saturday, targeting victims ranging in age from 29 to 85.
* **All 11 victims are expected to survive** , with six initially left in critical condition and five in serious condition, though by Sunday the conditions had improved to four in serious and seven in fair condition according to Munson Medical Center.
* **Perry is being praised as a hero for his actions** , with family members calling it a "proud daughter moment" and social media users suggesting he deserves recognition like the Presidential Medal of Freedom for his courage in stopping the attack.

* * *
# U.S. strikes major trade deal with Europe and markets love it
Global stocks rose and the euro strengthened after **[the US-EU trade deal imposed a 15% tariff](https://substack.com/redirect/37401848-087f-42a0-b02d-849d9f897a57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on most EU goods--half the threatened 30% rate--with analysts calling it "a big win for the US" that provides market stability and averts a larger trade war.
* **The agreement requires Europe to purchase $750 billion in US energy and military equipment with zero tariff retaliation** , leading strategists to describe it as "the art of the deal" rather than traditional negotiation, while countries scramble to finalize agreements before Trump's August 1 deadline.
* **Markets are positioning for a busy week of key policy meetings** including the Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan monetary policy decisions, monthly US employment data, and earnings from Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon, with both central banks expected to hold rates steady.
* **The trade clarity is boosting risk assets while reducing safe-haven demand** , with oil prices rising 0.5%, gold falling to two-week lows, and the Australian dollar hovering near eight-month highs as investors interpret the deals as signs of "controlled diplomacy over confrontation."

subject: My decision: I’m running for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I’m ready to serve again.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250728_1_splitroycooper?refcode=em20250728-1655&amount=5&refcode2=1655_582294_LY_SfW&akid=1655%2E582294%2ELY_SfW)
Hello,
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**
[**We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Chris Pappas to get us started off strong?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250728_1_splitroycooper?refcode=em20250728-1655&amount=20&refcode2=1655_582294_LY_SfW&akid=1655%2E582294%2ELY_SfW)

**These are no ordinary times.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There's another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you.
[**We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have Chris Pappas' support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Let’s do this together,
Roy Cooper

body:
I'm ready to serve again.
| | | [](https://go.dscc.org/go/21930?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20250728-RoyCooper-CooperLaunchTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20250728-RoyCooper-CooperLaunchTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=20864%2E9716520%2EWf2mLW)
With great humility and endless hope for the future of America, I have an announcement to make: **I am running for U.S. Senate.**

**I'm Roy Cooper.** I had the honor of serving North Carolina as Attorney General and Governor.

[**Now, I am asking for your support to serve our nation as the next Democratic United States Senator from North Carolina. I'm grateful that the DSCC is already on our team, and if you're ready to join us, please split a donation between our team and theirs right now >>>**](https://go.dscc.org/go/21930?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20250728-RoyCooper-CooperLaunchTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20250728-RoyCooper-CooperLaunchTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=20864%2E9716520%2EWf2mLW)

Democrats' best hope of stopping the chaos in Washington is to retake the Senate in 2026, and our race here in NC is set to be the most competitive election next year. We can't take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip.

Here's something you may not know about me: **I've already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina.** I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state.

NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we've proven together that Democrats _can_ win. We know what we have to do.

As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care more affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I'll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy.

Hello Derek,
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**
[**We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and the DNC to get us started off strong?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-cooper-split?refcode=em_20250728_4061_fr&amount=10&refcode2=4104_22930333_F433D1&akid=4104%2E22930333%2EF433D1)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-cooper-split?refcode=em_20250728_4061_fr&amount=20&refcode2=4104_22930333_F433D1&akid=4104%2E22930333%2EF433D1)**
**These are no ordinary times, Derek.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down_ — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give.
There’s another path, Derek. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Derek.
[**We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have the DNC's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and the DNC today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-cooper-split?refcode=em_20250728_4061_fr&amount=10&refcode2=4104_22930333_F433D1&akid=4104%2E22930333%2EF433D1)**

I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington. Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I’ve had enough. = | | = These are no ordinary times, Derek. I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty. When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe. They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give. There’s another path, Derek. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people. Washington can look like this, too. It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve. Victory for Free Speech in Colorado:
Moms for America
at the Center of Landmark Win

***

We’re excited to share a powerful win for constitutional rights and for Moms for America.

Last week, a federal jury unanimously ruled in favor of our very own Kelly Kohls, Senior Director at Moms for America, and Deborah
Schmidt, finding that Colorado’s District 49 school board president violated their First Amendment rights through viewpoint
discrimination at a public board meeting.

The jury awarded the maximum possible damages and issued personal fines against the board president, an extraordinary outcome in
cases like this. This is more than just a legal win, it’s a resounding affirmation of every parent’s right to speak up in their
community.

This all began when a courageous board member reached out to Moms for America for help. We stepped in to ensure the voices of
concerned parents were not silenced and this victory proves what’s possible when...

We Stand Together!

clean_body: We’re excited to share a powerful win for constitutional rights and for Moms for America. If you are having trouble viewing this email click here to view in your browser. [] [] * Victory for Free Speech in Colorado: Moms for America at the Center of Landmark Win * We’re excited to share a powerful win for constitutional rights and for Moms for America. Last week, a federal jury unanimously ruled in favor of our very own Kelly Kohls, Senior Director at Moms for America, and Deborah Schmidt, finding that Colorado’s District 49 school board president violated their First Amendment rights through viewpoint discrimination at a public board meeting. The jury awarded the maximum possible damages and issued personal fines against the board president, an extraordinary outcome in cases like this. This is more than just a legal win, it’s a resounding affirmation of every parent’s right to speak up in their community. This all began when a courageous board member reached out to Moms for America for help. We stepped in to ensure the voices of concerned parents were not silenced and this victory proves what’s possible when... We Stand Together! FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THIS VICTORY! Read the Press Release [] Thank you for your continued support in defending families, faith, and freedom! Consider donating to continue supporting moms like you across the country. Hello, Derek,
I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I’ve had enough.
We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Tim Kaine to get us started off strong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-cooper]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-cooper]
These are no ordinary times . I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give.
There’s another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
Washington can look like this, too. It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you.
We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have Tim's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. **These are no ordinary times, Peter.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity, and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment, and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Peter.

I’m ready to serve again.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250728-1?refcode=em20250728-2219&refcode2=2219_21716_4WwGQ_&akid=2219%2E21716%2E4WwGQ_)
With great humility and endless hope for the future of America, I have an announcement to make: **I am running for U.S. Senate.**
**I’m Roy Cooper.** I had the honor of serving North Carolina as Attorney General and Governor.
[**Now, I am asking for your support to serve our nation as the next Democratic United States Senator from North Carolina. I’m grateful that Congresswoman Sarah McBride is already on our team, and if you’re ready to join us, please split a donation between our team and theirs right now >>>**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250728-1?refcode=em20250728-2219&refcode2=2219_21716_4WwGQ_&akid=2219%2E21716%2E4WwGQ_)
Democrats’ best hope of stopping the chaos in Washington is to retake the Senate in 2026, and our race here in NC is set to be the most competitive election next year. We can’t take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip.
Here’s something you may not know about me: **I’ve already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina.** I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state.
NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we’ve proven together that Democrats _can_ win. We know what we have to do.
As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care _more_ affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I’ll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy.
**I will not back down. I refuse to let Republicans in Washington take this country backward.**
[**I have never taken running for office lightly, and I know that winning this race won’t be easy. But together, we’ve won the toughest fights before. We can win now. If you are with me, please make your grassroots Founding Donation today by splitting a contribution of any size between Congresswoman Sarah McBride and our campaign >>> **](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250728-1?refcode=em20250728-2219&refcode2=2219_21716_4WwGQ_&akid=2219%2E21716%2E4WwGQ_)

Thank you for being with me,
Roy Cooper

body:
I know her better than the liberal media, her Democrat opponent, and the DC establishment making the attack ads about her.

[](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvbpr97ia68pj7dqbb0dq3go1fen8ta20janibk8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)[](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zaci68j5ofo07f8h0f1cmcf561ur0od4qml68qso_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)Friend,
I'm Terence Sears, and I know my wife, Winsome, better than anyone else. I know her better than the liberal media, her Democrat opponent, and the DC establishment making the attack ads about her.
Winsome and I met serving in the Marines, and after she served for four years as an electrician, she left the military and we got married.[](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zesi21m1rcq5f0asb5retq4ae7ikjarrulc13gig_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)Sometimes, people ask her why she served her country even though she was an immigrant.
Her answer shows exactly who she is at her core: Because her dad was able to create a life in America after coming here with only $1.75 in his pocket, and she wanted to give back to the nation that gave her so much.
Winsome has spent her life giving back to her communities. She has a deep faith and trust in our Lord and follows His teachings to treat all her neighbors with kindness because she knows they were created in the image of God.
She has led a men's prison Bible study and served as the director of a women's homeless shelter, and that's the work she's most proud of in her life.
Her greatest achievement--aside from building our beautiful family--has been serving as the first Black female to hold statewide office as Virginia's Lieutenant Governor.[](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zn5ero43n8529dn9qgjh4jsos8p42gglrljf2fo8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)Virginia was once the capital of the Confederacy, and now, Virginia's second-in-command is a strong Black woman.
I'm so proud of my wife, but let me tell you - her work is nowhere near done.
Winsome Earle-Sears is running for Governor to keep spreading her positive conservative message and to show the nation that a Black female immigrant - or someone of any color or background - can accomplish anything they set their mind to in America.
So far, Winsome has seen such an amazing outpouring of support, but her opponent has George Soros' bottomless pockets on her side, so she's been massively outraised.[That's why I'm respectfully asking you to support the incredible, sincere, and inspiring woman that I married, Winsome Earle-Sears, with a donation of even just a few bucks.](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zt7v234kohron68ed2ss1vna2bgltc0obhpnmnhg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)[CHIP IN TO WINSOME >>
](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zrvc8kapdia2eb4dm4l25j00t5ianfncsltnv2q0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)She knows that this is going to be a long, tough fight, but there's no one better equipped for the job. She pours her heart and soul into everything she does, and serving as the first Black female governor in America will be no different.
Winsome will continue to see Jesus in everyone she meets, whether they're her political opponents, no matter their background, whether they're at rock bottom, or if they're thriving.[CHIP IN TO WINSOME FOR GOVERNOR >>
](http://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zbvg5jgsn7872u9pe2i1f98790gkcuv97mthhdmo_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj60p32clh2bs)We're both so happy you're on our side. If you can't afford to chip in even a dollar today, just keep us in your prayers.
Thank you, Terence Sears

Hello, Peter,
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**
[**We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Ruben Gallego to get us started off strong?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-cooper-em-split.bg1Cdu&refcode=em250728-1-160&t=2&akid=3926%2E734936%2EjwDrie)

When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.

TO: Stephen Colbert
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you. Dear Stephen Colbert,

**Thank you.** Your commitment to journalistic integrity and the truth over the last 10 years has been truly inspirational and has kept us all laughing through the MAGA madness.

While Fox News and other far-right outlets spew misinformation and conspiracy theories, you have been a constant, outstanding voice for our democracy.

**We know this is exactly the outcome that Trump and his MAGA cronies wished for — _and we are committed to fighting back tirelessly to protect the free press._**

While I’m going to miss seeing you on TV every night, I’m glad you’ll finally be getting the much-needed rest and recuperation you deserve.

[**So I’m signing this letter today by chipping in $3 to VPP to thank you for your years of service and to join VPP in the fight against Trump’s attacks on the free press. It is _absolutely critical_ that we elect good Democrats who will stand with your progressive values and honor your legacy, and we are so sad to see you go. »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92407?t=12&akid=20716%2E878179%2Eec7bXc) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92407?t=13&akid=20716%2E878179%2Eec7bXc) | [**CHIP IN $3 TO SIGN NOW »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92407?t=14&akid=20716%2E878179%2Eec7bXc)

name: Hillsdale College via Great America Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict

This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zb4esk965aj3im6p60oefq4fa0sda3ns1ausaq70_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68p76cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z7f5h5dqset9cf3s2otqdk8u4vind89liujfc5oo_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68p76cjh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zvnnd0qvn3nckkirm6qko2can83t65aaieies1ug_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68p76cjh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zt6guvsq7795kltnmhqd5bbra5h8aa23bj7cfec8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68p76cjh2bs)**

subject: You may not know this about my wife
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Winsome for Governor
body:
I know her better than the liberal media, her Democrat opponent, and the DC establishment making the attack ads about her.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zo2sruj3bq363iuf2c301jeclpke2li56b27oogg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zo0udevcpkudhemkptq7tp74nq5ah1pmhi6hhdpg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)Friend,
I'm Terence Sears, and I know my wife, Winsome, better than anyone else. I know her better than the liberal media, her Democrat opponent, and the DC establishment making the attack ads about her.
Winsome and I met serving in the Marines, and after she served for four years as an electrician, she left the military and we got married.[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3tjdd17856t9qp4gq0730entaalg5jp2g6a0f50_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)Sometimes, people ask her why she served her country even though she was an immigrant.
Her answer shows exactly who she is at her core: Because her dad was able to create a life in America after coming here with only $1.75 in his pocket, and she wanted to give back to the nation that gave her so much.
Winsome has spent her life giving back to her communities. She has a deep faith and trust in our Lord and follows His teachings to treat all her neighbors with kindness because she knows they were created in the image of God.
She has led a men's prison Bible study and served as the director of a women's homeless shelter, and that's the work she's most proud of in her life.
Her greatest achievement--aside from building our beautiful family--has been serving as the first Black female to hold statewide office as Virginia's Lieutenant Governor.[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zv22jqkn1ggumtis1gci4cp2i4pfl1i99h553t20_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)Virginia was once the capital of the Confederacy, and now, Virginia's second-in-command is a strong Black woman.
I'm so proud of my wife, but let me tell you - her work is nowhere near done.
Winsome Earle-Sears is running for Governor to keep spreading her positive conservative message and to show the nation that a Black female immigrant - or someone of any color or background - can accomplish anything they set their mind to in America.
So far, Winsome has seen such an amazing outpouring of support, but her opponent has George Soros' bottomless pockets on her side, so she's been massively outraised.[That's why I'm respectfully asking you to support the incredible, sincere, and inspiring woman that I married, Winsome Earle-Sears, with a donation of even just a few bucks.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zul516a6i3r2e1d8lh3jd50a5qnqs88068bqotio_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)[CHIP IN TO WINSOME >>
](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdfk43pjaqfdll2ldn7msc5ldplutie4k14ol9to_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)She knows that this is going to be a long, tough fight, but there's no one better equipped for the job. She pours her heart and soul into everything she does, and serving as the first Black female governor in America will be no different.
Winsome will continue to see Jesus in everyone she meets, whether they're her political opponents, no matter their background, whether they're at rock bottom, or if they're thriving.[CHIP IN TO WINSOME FOR GOVERNOR >>
](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z78tu4q1b2smojgisqk07iu4joi6in4veq6opkb0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj68o36clh2bs)We're both so happy you're on our side. If you can't afford to chip in even a dollar today, just keep us in your prayers.
Thank you, Terence Sears

# Shasta County Calls Out LaMalfa for Betraying Constituents
---
| Dear friends,As some of you know, I recently became chair of the Shasta County Democratic Central Committee (DCC)—and we have been busy!
We passed a resolution condemning U.S. Rep. Doug LaMalfa's vote in favor of H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which directly harms Shasta County residents by raising our taxes, cutting our benefits, and decimating our farm workforce.
Then we began spreading the word about this terrible giveaway to billionaires at the expense of everyday people. We’ve shared the Shasta County DCC resolution with other DCCs in District 1; so far, the Yuba County DCC has followed our lead and sent a Resolution to LaMalfa as well as to CD 3 Republican incumbent Kiley. In addition, I wrote a letter to the editor urging accountability for LaMalfa, which [published in A News Cafe](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=1c0d6361c3&e=8c53948e4c)—I’m sharing it below and encourage you to pass it on.
Also this month, I joined Carl and Linda Bott on their Free Fire Radio talk show, where they asked about my [5 Freedoms priorities](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=6c0316a8b9&e=8c53948e4c) and my student activism against the Marcos dictatorship in the Philippines.
I hope you see you soon—at parties, picnics, resistance activities, and everywhere people gather to create a caring community.
**Let’s organize. Let’s mobilize. Let’s stand up for what’s right.**

## Holding LaMalfa Accountable

Elected officials must represent their constituents—that is the foundation of our democracy. We elect them, trusting that they will serve our interests, not betray them.
Congressman Doug LaMalfa has failed that trust. His vote for the so-called One Big Beautiful Bill threatens healthcare for nearly 70,000 Medi-Cal recipients in Shasta County alone—38% of our population. Delivering Medi-Cal services to recipients is dependent on $940 million in critical federal funding, which this bill will severely cut. Meanwhile, LaMalfa had no hesitation supporting the $8.7 billion Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Act. He voted to give $8.7 billion to a nation that already guarantees healthcare for its citizens. Why does he prioritize foreign interests over his own constituents’ health and well-being?
We, voters and taxpayers of Shasta County, demand accountability. All over CA Congressional District 1, protests are growing. In Shasta County, we rally outside his Redding office every 4th Friday (9-11AM). Neither LaMalfa nor his staff will face us. Their silence speaks volumes.
Now, we’re taking formal action: a Resolution condemning his vote for what should rightly be called the "Big Ugly Bill."
We pay his salary. LaMalfa should work for us. It’s time he remembers that.
_Rose Penelope Yee_

## Upcoming Action Opportunities

**July 31:** The Democratic Action Club of Chico is holding a demonstration celebrating 60 years of Medicare and Medicaid from 9 to 10 a.m. at the Social Security/Medicare Office, 1370 E. Lassen Ave., Chico. Join them and their co-sponsors, North State Medicare 4 All and the statewide Healthy California Now coalition, to show your support for a healthcare system that puts people over profits. Demonstrations continue on subsequent Fridays from 9 to 10 am.

He voted to give $8.7 billion to a nation that already guarantees healthcare for its citizens. Why does he prioritize foreign interests over his own constituents’ health and well-being? We, voters and taxpayers of Shasta County, demand accountability. All over CA Congressional District 1, protests are growing. In Shasta County, we rally outside his Redding office every 4th Friday (9-11AM). Neither LaMalfa nor his staff will face us. Their silence speaks volumes. Now, we’re taking formal action: a Resolution condemning his vote for what should rightly be called the "Big Ugly Bill." We pay his salary. LaMalfa should work for us. It’s time he remembers that. With great humility and endless hope for the future of America, I have an announcement to make: **I am running for U.S. Senate, friend.**

**I’m Roy Cooper.** I had the honor of serving North Carolina as Attorney General and Governor.
**[Now, I am asking for your support to serve our nation as the next Democratic United States Senator from North Carolina. I’m grateful that Senator Blumenthal is already on our team, and if you’re ready to join us, please split a donation between our team and theirs right now >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112279013/559997677/-672561482?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1412-bu-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTRjZTRkZWItY2I2Yi1mMDExLThkYzktNjA0NWJkYTlkOTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ObXRp7TE6qnYLY69Bnm6BRf-IYR_mM7gWimkxNjvxvo=)**
Democrats’ best hope of stopping the chaos in Washington is to retake the Senate in 2026, and our race here in NC is set to be the most competitive election next year. We can’t take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip.

Here’s something you may not know about me: I’ve already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina. I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state.
NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we’ve proven together that Democrats can win. We know what we have to do.

As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care more affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I’ll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy.
**I will not back down. I refuse to let Republicans in Washington take this country backward.**

**[I have never taken running for office lightly, friend, and I know that winning this race won’t be easy. But together, we’ve won the toughest fights before. We can win now.
