| | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zta24octr7n5vne36t2ms05u1f9ij6vbprp4pkj0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdlgkrohtehllrjmdfkaq536chpd7p6skqj5suno_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp7gfrj9neb6r7bvsjg3b28r0jr1jgi50g53kbi0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zou09g0tcp5rlrn89t1lmphbv41ns537vale7b8o_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.**Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0jj9dihufttknvp6idm4kidn1ueq0okjr503768_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.**What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. **[That’s why, when you’ve signed your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z64q7vesibigtd6mhg7eskmipc33lngra28nb9n8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs), I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions.** The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. _It means we can’t be bought._ On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling _billions_ to dark money “non-profit” groups to “**reshape** ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – **[your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution is vitally important.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4s72f86i00n3ard6140imn7qf2egshvc646oj2g_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj64o74clh2bs)** Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting _and_ banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. Thank you in advance for joining the fight to secure your vote

clean_body: As a former Navy SEAL, I’ve dodged my fair share of bullets, so believe me when I tell you that as a nation, we’ve never dodged a bigger bullet than Kamala Harris. | Fellow Conservative, A little over a year ago, Joe Biden dropped out of the race for President of the United States, and Kamala Harris began her rapid ascent to the top of the political world. Kamala Harris was woefully unprepared to be her party's standard-bearer, and luckily for you and me, America thought so, too. As a former Navy SEAL, I've dodged my fair share of bullets, so believe me when I tell you that as a nation, we've never dodged a bigger bullet than Kamala Harris. However, the progressive movement that propelled her onto Biden's 2020 ticket shows no signs of slowing. The Democrats that you grew up with are dead. You'd think there would be more soul-searching for a party that twice lost the highest prize in politics to Donald Trump. Yet, that doesn't seem to be the case. Just last week, famed political commentator James Carville called the Democrat Party a "cracked-out clown car." Isn't that saying something when your harshest critic is one of your most famous members? I'm looking for your help here, Fname. I'm a former Navy SEAL and first-time political candidate running as a Republican in Minnesota. My likely opponent is Tim Walz's lieutenant governor, someone who considers herself even more progressive than AOC. I'm James O'Keefe, founder of O'Keefe Media Group (OMG), where we risk everything to expose corruption through undercover journalism.

His baseless claims--defamation, fraud, wiretapping--**are meant to bankrupt us**.

As I told the Associated Press, "This is an attack against the First Amendment... the process is the punishment."

If Mannina's defamation claim wins, **it 's over for OMG**.

Our "American Swiper" program, which drives our exposes, could spark countless lawsuits from others we've exposed, ending our work.

**We have just 21 days from being served to hire top D.C. attorneys and respond, or we risk losing by default**.

Liberty Guard is hosting our legal defense fund, and [**I 'm asking you to join our fight with a donation today.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zlu24scr2v2pkdmb2s5l48egkoe74ct3g0r60ng0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj6cpr2cph2bs)

Please donate today to stand with OMG and save press freedom.

More than ever, I need patriots like you to help respond by this 21-day deadline and keep the OMG alive and allow us to **keep fighting corruption with the truth**.

[**Your support will defend not just OMG but the right to fearless journalism.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zommv79ke1bjnfp5sfgnh7028pimmoon4kvbgrn0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6ctj6cpr2cph2bs)

James O’Keefe

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
I’m ready to serve again.
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250728_1_ak?refcode=em20250728-39930&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39930_3422442_JsepSy&akid=39930%2E3422442%2EJsepSy)
With great humility and endless hope for the future of America, I have an announcement to make: **I am running for U.S. Senate, Peter.**
**I’m Roy Cooper.** I had the honor of serving North Carolina as Attorney General and Governor.
**[Now, I am asking for your support to serve our nation as the next Democratic United States Senator from North Carolina. I’m grateful that Katie Porter is already on our team, and if you’re ready to join us, please split a donation between our team and Katie's right now>>>](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250728_1_ak?refcode=em20250728-39930&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39930_3422442_JsepSy&akid=39930%2E3422442%2EJsepSy)**
Democrats’ best hope of stopping the chaos in Washington is to retake the Senate in 2026, and our race here in NC is set to be the most competitive election next year. We can’t take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip.
Here’s something you may not know about me: **I’ve already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina.** I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state.
NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we’ve proven together that Democrats can win. We know what we have to do.
As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care more affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I’ll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy.
**I will not back down. I refuse to let Republicans in Washington take this country backward.**
**[I have never taken running for office lightly, Peter, and I know that winning this race won’t be easy. But together, we’ve won the toughest fights before. We can win now. body:
I’m ready to serve again.
#

Hey friend, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Roy Cooper is running for Senate in North Carolina and needs our help. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**rush a split donation between Roy's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-cooper.oMEak6&refcode=em250728-1-90&t=1&akid=6134%2E6688874%2EwblNq9)

---
Hello,
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**
[**We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Mark Kelly to get us started off strong?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-cooper.oMEak6&refcode=em250728-1-90&t=3&akid=6134%2E6688874%2EwblNq9)

**These are no ordinary times.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you.
[**We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have Mark Kelly's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and Mark Kelly today.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-cooper.oMEak6&refcode=em250728-1-90&t=5&akid=6134%2E6688874%2EwblNq9)

Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress.** My role as your representative is to work for you, listen to your concerns, and stand up against the Republican Rip-Off. **This month, I was pleased to announce that funding for several Northwest Washington transportation projects has been released by the Department of Transportation so local governments can move forward with their work as expected.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112287138/560017493/-376801804?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzBkYTliMy1kNTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QCZWxOMUqAKAO3ZiqmE7YWHcZYrkTkHKKtrv_DWMgqQ=&emci=a9d833cc-ab68-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&emdi=1c0da9b3-d56b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239) **[Read Article](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112287139/560017494/-376801804?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzBkYTliMy1kNTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QCZWxOMUqAKAO3ZiqmE7YWHcZYrkTkHKKtrv_DWMgqQ=&emci=a9d833cc-ab68-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&emdi=1c0da9b3-d56b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239)** As the top Democrat on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I have been laser-focused on bringing home good news where I can and leading essential bipartisan efforts for transportation and infrastructure. Last month, I shared news that Trump, Secretary of Labor Lori Chavez-DeRemer, and the Republican Rip-Off closed the Job Corps program in their efforts to give a tax break to the richest Americans and wealthiest corporations. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112287140/560017495/1939607274?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzBkYTliMy1kNTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QCZWxOMUqAKAO3ZiqmE7YWHcZYrkTkHKKtrv_DWMgqQ=&emci=a9d833cc-ab68-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&emdi=1c0da9b3-d56b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239) **[Read Article](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112287141/560017496/1939607274?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzBkYTliMy1kNTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QCZWxOMUqAKAO3ZiqmE7YWHcZYrkTkHKKtrv_DWMgqQ=&emci=a9d833cc-ab68-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&emdi=1c0da9b3-d56b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ceid=9494239)** After the Administration announced that terrible decision to close all Job Corps centers, I met with local leaders, former Job Corps students, and folks around the region about the negative impact this would have. **The people I spoke to wanted me and the community to rally behind Cascade Job Corps Center and fight to keep it open, and that is exactly what we did.** Late last month, a federal judge blocked the Administration's decision to close the Job Corps centers. **Cascade Job Corps Center is returning to the important work of helping young people in Northwest Washington state complete college credits and professional certifications.** More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution to Rick Larsen instantly:

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250728-1?refcode=em-20250728-1&refcode2=371_1086043_hShPO2&akid=371%2E1086043%2EhShPO2)
Hello, Peter.
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk -- just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**
**[We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Wes Moore to get us started off strong?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250728-1?refcode=em-20250728-1&refcode2=371_1086043_hShPO2&akid=371%2E1086043%2EhShPO2)**
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250728-1?refcode=em-20250728-1&refcode2=371_1086043_hShPO2&akid=371%2E1086043%2EhShPO2)**
**These are no ordinary times, Peter.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down -- attacking the most vulnerable among us -- to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Peter.
**[We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have Governor Moore's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and Wes Moore today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250728-1?refcode=em-20250728-1&refcode2=371_1086043_hShPO2&akid=371%2E1086043%2EhShPO2)**
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250728-1?amount=10&refcode=em-20250728-1&refcode2=371_1086043_hShPO2&akid=371%2E1086043%2EhShPO2)**
Let’s do this together,
Roy Cooper

Hi Peter, let me tell you a story about perseverance. The only college I applied to was the University of North Carolina. I attended for 2 years through scholarships and grants but eventually left to work after I could no longer sustain the tuition costs. I went back a few years later for one semester, but even then, I couldn’t manage working and studying full time. I got married, and had my children, but I always felt like _something_ was missing. The thing is, Peter, I’m not a quitter, but I had quit school. I felt like I had let down my friends who had graduated college, and wanted to be an example for my children on how to accomplish goals – but mostly, I had this fire within me to succeed. So, over 25 years later, I went back to UNC and earned a bachelor’s degree in Political Science and Afro and African-American studies. I attended for 2 years through scholarships and grants but eventually left to work after I could no longer sustain the tuition costs. I went back a few years later for one semester, but even then, I couldn’t manage working and studying full time. I got married, and had my children, but I always felt like something was missing. The thing is, Peter, I’m not a quitter, but I had quit school. I felt like I had let down my friends who had graduated college, and wanted to be an example for my children on how to accomplish goals – but mostly, I had this fire within me to succeed. So, over 25 years later, I went back to UNC and earned a bachelor’s degree in Political Science and Afro and African-American studies. For those 4 semesters, I was a dean’s list student while working as a County Commissioner. The moral of the story? It’s not about how many times you get knocked down – it’s about getting back up. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.** Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich.**I’ve had enough.** **[We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Kristen McDonald Rivet to get us started off strong?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112289381/560024390/-541230694?refcode=em-7.28.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzk4NDc5My1kYTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wBKtsPsWcjmFdNuOPWA0juSgLeVJBkzQAEo7W23JTjI=)** | [Donate ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112289389/560024400/-541230694?refcode=em-7.28.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYzk4NDc5My1kYTZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wBKtsPsWcjmFdNuOPWA0juSgLeVJBkzQAEo7W23JTjI=)

These are no ordinary times, folks. I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, folks. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, folks.
[**We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington. Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich.I’ve had enough. = | = These are no ordinary times, folks. I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty. When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe. They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give. There’s another path, folks. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people. Washington can look like this, too. name: Tim Kaine
subject: On being a good neighbor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Earlier this month, before Senate Republicans jammed through President Trump’s disastrous rescissions package that cuts $9 billion from programs like PBS, NPR, and foreign aid, I told a story on the Senate floor.
I want to share it with you. It’s not a short story, but I hope you’ll read it because I think this is really important to reflect on:
The church where my wife Anne and I were married more than 40 years ago, where all three of our children were baptized, and where we attended mass this past Sunday is called Saint Elizabeth’s of Hungary.
It’s a small, humble Catholic parish in the north side of Richmond, Virginia that was founded more than a hundred years ago by Italian and German immigrants who wanted a place where they could feel loved, safe, and welcomed as they worshiped. As Catholic refugees in the aftermath of World War I, they felt looked down upon because of where they’d come from and the accents they spoke with.
They named the church after Saint Elizabeth, a Hungarian princess from the thirteenth century who went against the wishes of her husband to feed the poor. Eventually, she gave up her wealth and devoted the rest of her life to caring for the sick and poor.
The founders of my church a hundred years ago knew that was what was needed in the world — a place of worship for people who believed in serving those in need.
Fast forward to about 15 years ago, when a Congolese family was resettled from a refugee camp into my church by a Catholic organization offering refugee resettlement services. They liked the church — a place where they also felt loved, safe, and welcomed — and over time, other Congolese refugee families started to come, too.
Today, my church has a sizable Congolese refugee population — and while at first glance, our congregation looks different from a hundred years ago, in many ways, it is just the same.
So why did I tell this story? Let’s go back to Trump’s rescissions bill.
The bill rescinded funding for essential programs millions of people rely on – including refugee resettlement programs. These programs follow the law and help those who are accessing legal refugee programs find safety, integrate into our society, and live with dignity in America. This is good work that is at the core of who we are as Americans.
Trump’s package wiped out funding for virtually all of these organizations, which means staff layoffs and program closures — some of which have been operating for decades or more than a century.
These cuts will have a profound impact on millions of people here in the U.S. and across the globe.
Derek, I can’t say that I’m surprised Trump would propose such massive cuts that disproportionately impact the most vulnerable among us. After all, the language, rhetoric, and behavior that he’s exhibited toward even legal immigrants and refugees have paved the way for this moment.
I’m not even particularly surprised that many of my colleagues in the House and the Senate would accept these cuts without much protest, in light of their recent votes to gut Medicaid and nutritional assistance programs.
But what I am surprised by is the fact that so many of those who voted in favor of these cuts go to churches just like me, and hear sermons just like I do on bedrock beliefs like this one:
Matthew 25:35 — I was a stranger and you welcomed me in. I was sick and you cared for me. I was hungry and you fed me.
The idea of being a good neighbor transcends religions.
Caring for your neighbor is a simple idea embraced by every culture and belief system, and yet far too many of our elected officials have abandoned these core, human beliefs in favor of gaining power or even simply avoiding censure from Trump.
I’m going to be honest: I don’t know what the future holds for these resettlement programs, or for the people who rely on them. What I do know is that I’m more committed than ever to standing up for the vulnerable and fighting against injustice — both here in the Senate and out in the community.
I hope you’ll join me in looking for opportunities to get involved — to be a good neighbor — and to do whatever you can, whenever you can for those who need it most.
Now more than ever before, we must not grow jaded or disconnected from our core values, whether they come from our religion, our patriotism, our families, or anywhere else.
Thanks for reading,
Tim

Williamsburg, VA 23185

Hello, Derek,
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in D.C. are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor, and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich.**I’ve had enough.**
**[We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and John Fetterman's campaign to get us started off strong?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51476?refcode=jtk196-bu-fl&t=2&akid=10225%2E434096%2EZNAWAh)**
| | [DONATE](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51476?refcode=jtk196-bu-fl&t=3&akid=10225%2E434096%2EZNAWAh)
---
**These are no ordinary times,****Derek.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity, and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, Derek. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Derek.
**[We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have John Fetterman's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and John Fetterman's today.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51476?refcode=jtk196-bu-fl&t=4&akid=10225%2E434096%2EZNAWAh)**

Donald Trump and the MAGA movement are already plotting to rig the 2026 elections, and Trump’s using his Justice Department takeover to do it.

clean_body: | | | North Carolinians already know this about me, Friend: I've spent my life in service to our state, and my record shows that I will do everything in my power to deliver results for our people. That's why North Carolinians elected me Governor in some of the most competitive races in the nation -- twice. Now, this election is set to be the most competitive Senate race of 2026, and the national GOP will go to any lengths to defeat us. Everyone knows that the path to retaking the Senate Majority and STOPPING Washington Republicans starts here in NC. Friend, I have a long record of getting things done -- from taking on big banks as Attorney General to getting Medicaid expansion passed when I was Governor. I'm not afraid of doing hard work to make our country better. And I'm not afraid to speak out when politicians are doing something wrong, either. Too many Republicans in Washington have lost all sense of duty to our people and our country. They see only the prospect of getting on Donald Trump's wrong side and losing their power. This cannot continue. Americans deserve leaders who will serve the people, not their own partisan agenda. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has handpicked a loyalist candidate to run against me. As Senator, I will defend our democracy. I'll stand up for voting rights, work hard to restore abortion access, advocate for policies that will protect our air and drinking water, and do everything possible to bring jobs and opportunity to our economy. We’re building a people-powered movement anchored by community care and connection. | | | Hi Peter, it’s Claudia with United We Dream. Last week, we shared a powerful example of your support in action: **Our East Coast Member Gathering.** Now, I want to show you the impact you made on rising youth advocates. __ **[Before I do, will you make a $5 donation to power more training events like our Member Gathering?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeseKeguBhueYD3zJ5W7-Ttq8bIH6IT4QCwA3YdxQZoNugp-ikDf5UnEKAlnuVuAr3_Pgxt8DA0Fk-q_Jn9QOeKXledOP2vgiQUA-zoRFX6Mn5gTYgZojZV7ijN0zx4ZXzlXoGqijUXCnVRaLgUyz4nswDwFJdPrRUGZAhG1r6V1eYd3wbzpr8EEkxaeZVGdehCxiJQF6eRdbXqg65PVnsIYvslsBfj_6Rnz55rFutjiY0TLlK_QBNVQLPXF5DkS8b34lL2NpPJ15cNu3Pcol76Mt94nJ3ZqaRGrzMQ1S-fbs-_r5vqx2FN-qKbiYZV7MSghQ-oVJFVSQGpi3zQ8U_WXrMqhTogunhIboEQGEoeZNWaglu8wTxfKqqdBvyFVcOEXAm7-f3cPcjAL1bWqY5kI28nX7Ty7R5oMcftYDG880/4ik/zvv44_ZaTBOvE6aNMCZi3w/h0/h001.b0zz3_ybfSy0_zgB7CK9S9_m0-dHLlY1g7sy1-m6NXQ)** | | [DONATE $5](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeseKeguBhueYD3zJ5W7-Ttq8bIH6IT4QCwA3YdxQZoNugp-ikDf5UnEKAlnuVuAr3_Pgxt8DA0Fk-q_Jn9QOeKXI5a8McYHs5I9D98mMxVUgbwMVTiv2VlIDMFJIVgb1CudiUDP0OhYGT81nrTjTn8Yj80a07pNQUDOmdgbG9DGppo6qjP-2kzvVbE9oz9Nuv4JjA_6wrtbNH9MCR5U6VB1yb_Zz3zLd2nV_f-S561PRu7hGYyJ2Rr1TrFGqYb6am7xegWuB2sDCYmfILs4Q4qOygTqwYl2yhSb4ACMEVEVHCUwHlcwlBUQ3gDXhZOc5W7_mf8rNCzUBcR1uPlRrgpH0mYlWQEwCe5dGHOjPEXOdLLavRqHs8FprGLH6L8oUjHm5G6vahqgZI-nU377oiQdGp4KgNvxV6aCySHmgtW48/4ik/zvv44_ZaTBOvE6aNMCZi3w/h1/h001.EItjdQGOxXCAUZNkSfLyNOOgR9bdVIMfP_6Upf84oiA)

After two and a half days of training, community-building exercises, and _fun_ , our members stepped away from our Member Gathering with the tools and encouragement they need to be changemakers in their communities.
One member expressed that our gathering didn’t just help improve their skills as an organizer, but it also showed them that **the change we need comes from the heart** — _from acts of love, inclusion, and compassion._
Another member from Maryland told us that she is excited to bring the tools she learned back home. In the county she resides in, there is a large immigrant population, and now, **she feels prepared to ensure her undocumented and mixed-status neighbors know their rights and voice in the fight for justice.**
But one remark really stuck with me. One of the members said that our gathering reminded them that **we’re not fighting alone** , and that is so important. Experiencing local struggles alone can be isolating, but the community we built renewed a sense of connection for so many organizers.
From Texas to Maryland to California to Florida, we’re building a people-powered movement anchored by community care and connection. Your support is fueling something real, Peter, and we want to keep going.

clean_body: We’re building a people-powered movement anchored by community care and connection. | | | Hi Peter, it’s Claudia with United We Dream. Last week, we shared a powerful example of your support in action: Our East Coast Member Gathering. Now, I want to show you the impact you made on rising youth advocates. | | After two and a half days of training, community-building exercises, and fun , our members stepped away from our Member Gathering with the tools and encouragement they need to be changemakers in their communities. One member expressed that our gathering didn’t just help improve their skills as an organizer, but it also showed them that the change we need comes from the heart — from acts of love, inclusion, and compassion. Another member from Maryland told us that she is excited to bring the tools she learned back home. In the county she resides in, there is a large immigrant population, and now, she feels prepared to ensure her undocumented and mixed-status neighbors know their rights and voice in the fight for justice. But one remark really stuck with me. One of the members said that our gathering reminded them that we’re not fighting alone , and that is so important. Experiencing local struggles alone can be isolating, but the community we built renewed a sense of connection for so many organizers. From Texas to Maryland to California to Florida, we’re building a people-powered movement anchored by community care and connection. Your support is fueling something real, Peter, and we want to keep going. **These are no ordinary times, Peter.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Peter.
[We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have the Democratic Party of Georgia's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Peter, One of the first rules of propaganda is, “never allow the public to cool off.” It’s barely been six months since Donald Trump has been sworn in, and I can already see the headline fatigue on everyone’s faces. Rest and self-care is so important to strong, united organizing and results. That, as well as my own sanity, is why I promise you I will never email you each and every time Donald Trump acts out. None of us have the energy for that, and after a while it’s just shouting into the wind. But in these unique times, we _need_ to stay connected, and I will be reaching out around meaningful updates in Washington, key deadlines, and if (or more likely, when) our race heats up. That brings me to this: our July fundraising deadline. **It feels early, but National Republicans are already making decisions on which districts to target, and they’re already floating hit pieces on me to try and flip IL-17.** Trust me, I’d like a longer break too, but it’s the nature of the district. That’s also why it’s so important that we start this quarter with a strong fundraising close to the month – nothing will have the NRCC avoiding our district like a large, early display of support that tells them to buzz off. And the earlier we can seal off a challenge, we can use that time and effort to help friends in red-to-blue districts around me so we can have a blue House to cut off the worst far-right impulses. [**So if you’re in this fight to keep our nation on track with me, I’m humbly asking you to pitch in $3 to help us close January with a message of intent. \- We need to set the record straight

| |
---
Over the weekend, we sent out an email — “Let’s play Two Truths & a Lie.”

It was brought to our attention that we made an error; we listed a Republican who is not a member of Congress as voting for Trump’s Big Bullshit Bill. That’s on us. Our bad.

So let’s correct the record and make sure every Pennsylvanian knows who actually voted for that terrible bill. Here are ALL of the US House Republican Representatives from Pennsylvania who voted yes for Trump’s Big Bullshit Bill — **every. single. one. of. them:**
* Rep. Ryan Mackenzie (PA-7)
* Rep. Robert Bresnahan (PA-8)
* Rep. Daniel Meuser (PA-9)
* Rep. Scott Perry (PA-10)
* Rep. Lloyd Smucker (PA-11)
* Rep. John Joyce (PA-13)
* Rep. Guy Reschenthaler (PA-14)
* Rep. Glenn Thompson (PA-15)
* Rep. Mike Kelly (PA-16)

All nine voted for Trump’s Big Bullshit Bill, a disastrous piece of legislation that **cuts billions from Medicaid** , putting healthcare for millions of Pennsylvanians at risk, **including seniors, veterans, and families who depend on these services** — it also **slashes funding for SNAP and food assistance programs** , making it harder for working families to put food on the table, all while **exploding our deficit by an additional 5 TRILLION dollars**.

[We can’t let them get away with it. **July 28, 2025** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Readers,
This week, we’re sounding the alarm on one of the biggest underreported threats to Colorado’s future: **[the quiet takeover of federal energy decisions by state regulators.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In 2024, a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and Colorado’s Energy and Carbon Management Commission (ECMC) changed everything. Sold as a tool for cooperation, it’s now being used by anti-fossil fuel actors in our state to block drilling on federal land—even with federal permits in hand.
Colorado producers are being boxed in by overlapping mandates, county-level obstruction, and environmental litigation. Operators like Petrox Resources are walking away from decades-long projects. [Others say they won’t invest in Colorado again unless the MOU is repealed.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**And make no mistake—this is political.** The original 2009 MOU kept federal control where it belonged. The 2024 rewrite flips the script, giving state agencies co-lead authority over federal minerals. It’s a dangerous blueprint that could spread beyond Colorado unless Congress steps in.
Rocky Mountain Voice was the first outlet to break this story wide open—and we have our editor Jen Schumann to thank for her incredible work on this investigative piece. She’s brought light to a complex but critical issue that the mainstream press refuses to touch.
This isn’t just about energy—it’s about sovereignty, jobs, and the truth.
Stay sharp. Stay bold. And stay tuned. We’ll keep digging.
**[📲 Read the full investigative report here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In liberty and truth,
Heidi Ganahl

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Gertrude Stein wrote her oft-repeated line “A rose is a rose is a rose...” in a 1913 poem. She explained it as meaning “things are what they are.” But what if it’s called something else? That was Juliet’s question to Romeo: “What’s in a name? That which we call a rose, by any other name would smell as sweet.” Shakespeare argued that whatever we call something, it is still what it is._

While it's not found in standard dictionaries, the longest dictionary-approved word is the 45-letter lung disease _pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis_. And of course, who could forget _supercalifragilisticexpialidocious_ —the longest made-up word most of us actually know!

clean_body: EXCLUSIVE: How one state agency is blocking federal drilling in Colorado | | | | July 28, 2025 MONDAY NEWS DIGEST | | Dear Readers, This week, we’re sounding the alarm on one of the biggest underreported threats to Colorado’s future: In 2024, a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and Colorado’s Energy and Carbon Management Commission (ECMC) changed everything. Sold as a tool for cooperation, it’s now being used by anti-fossil fuel actors in our state to block drilling on federal land—even with federal permits in hand. Colorado producers are being boxed in by overlapping mandates, county-level obstruction, and environmental litigation. Operators like Petrox Resources are walking away from decades-long projects. And make no mistake—this is political. The original 2009 MOU kept federal control where it belonged. The 2024 rewrite flips the script, giving state agencies co-lead authority over federal minerals. It’s a dangerous blueprint that could spread beyond Colorado unless Congress steps in. Rocky Mountain Voice was the first outlet to break this story wide open—and we have our editor Jen Schumann to thank for her incredible work on this investigative piece. She’s brought light to a complex but critical issue that the mainstream press refuses to touch. This isn’t just about energy—it’s about sovereignty, jobs, and the truth. Stay sharp. Stay bold. And stay tuned. We’ll keep digging. In liberty and truth, Heidi Ganahl | | | TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK We’ve been in the trenches for a long time here in Colorado. For years, it’s felt like one loss after another—on parental rights, on fiscal responsibility, on election integrity. But something has shifted. In this week’s episode of Unleashed, I talk about the wins we’re finally starting to see—and why they matter more than ever. In September 2024, a document quietly signed by BLM Colorado Director Doug Vilsack just eight weeks before the Presidential election may have done more than establish interagency cooperation. Critics say it handed away federal power. At the Mountain Majesty Gala last month, the room was on its feet. Eric Trump had just wrapped his keynote, a message aimed straight at the grassroots: Colorado is yearning to be red. But the loud applause that night wasn’t reserved only for the headliner. It also came when everyday Coloradans—organizers, volunteers and first-time leaders—were called up for something new: the first Trailblazer Awards. | STATE In Craig, a coal worker with $60,000 in retirement savings could lose $6,000 of it overnight—just for trying to survive after losing his job. That’s the reality hundreds of families are facing in Northwest Colorado, where coal plants and mines are shutting down years ahead of schedule and federal tax law is punishing livelihoods already in freefall. This August, as educators across the country prepare for a new school year, veteran teacher and author Priscilla Rahn is offering something more than just a back-to-school refresher—she’s offering a movement. A secretly recorded cellphone conversation between ranchers and a Colorado Parks and Wildlife wolf depredation investigator exposed how agency investigations receive top-down influence to alter the number of confirmed wolf depredations. | NATIONAL America First Legal (AFL) has brought renewed attention to the termination of 18 National Institutes of Health (NIH) grants in 2025, sharing a detailed report in a thread posted on X on July 16. The group’s findings highlight a series of projects it characterizes as race-based and ideologically driven—grants funded during the Biden Administration and later canceled under new Trump Administration directives. On Tuesday, Department of Homeland Security (DHS) officials announced the arrest of several illegal aliens, including 52-year-old Federico Fong-Nunez of Mexico. Fong-Nunez has been convicted of 21 different crimes in Boulder, Colorado, including burglary, aggravated assault, and felony menacing. A federal appeals court ruled in favor of MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell on Wednesday in his bid to avoid paying $5 million to a software developer who declared victory in Lindell’s contest to disprove his claims of foreign interference in the 2020 election. | LOCAL With longstanding principles of objectivity, truth and fairness in news reporting up for debate in recent years, a homegrown Career and Technical Education course launching in Colorado Springs School District 11 for the fall semester will explore such topics under an overarching theme of “ethics in journalism.” U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officials announced Wednesday that 243 people were arrested in the Denver metro area who the agency says are “currently charged with or have been convicted of criminal offenses after illegally entering the United States.” The Las Colonias Riverfront Zip Adventures zip line, which was launched after initial delays in August 2023, then shut down partway through 2024, remains inactive in 2025. | COMMENTARY Gertrude Stein wrote her oft-repeated line “A rose is a rose is a rose...” in a 1913 poem. She explained it as meaning “things are what they are.” But what if it’s called something else? That was Juliet’s question to Romeo: “What’s in a name? That which we call a rose, by any other name would smell as sweet.” Shakespeare argued that whatever we call something, it is still what it is. They called him the Prince of Darkness, a man whose voice shook stadiums and whose image terrified a generation of churchgoers. Ozzy Osbourne was never the poster child for purity. He bit bats, howled at moons, and lived through headlines that left even the tabloids gasping. And yet, strangely enough, it was Ozzy—not a pastor or prophet—who helped spark a light in my soul. Contracts. Impasse. Mediation. Oh my! We’ve all seen the headlines, the crowd of red shirts, and the talking points about “fighting for teachers and students.” But as a teacher—and a former union member—I’m here to tell you: what’s happening with the Mesa Valley Education Association (MVEA) isn’t about students. clean_body: | = Peter, I just checked our fundraising numbers going into the end of the month, and I'll be honest: we're behind where we need to be. As the leader of the digital team, I'm responsible for tracking our online fundraising totals and making sure we hit our projections so that Democratic pro-choice women have the resources they need to power their campaigns, month after month. But that only works when this community shows up. So,Peter, we need to act fast to catch up. To hit projections and deliver for our women, we've set a $200,000 End-of-Month goal, which we're officially launching today. | = This goal isn't just a number — it's our strategy in action. Every dollar raised goes toward: Electing more Democratic pro-choice women governors (two of whom are on the ballot THIS NOVEMBER!) Taking back power in the U.S. House Ensuring abortion rights remain protected in Virginia Supporting our mayors on the frontlines And so much more. Every dollar we raise before midnight Thursday helps us get closer to that $200,000 goal — and ensures we don't have to scale back when it matters most. **=** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you, Christen Sparago (they/she) Chief Digital Officer, EMILYs List = | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. Peter Willis,

This is it. The battle for the future of the Democratic Party has reached
a breaking point – and Zohran Mamdani is at the center of a fierce fight.

The oligarchs, billionaires, and political establishment are dead-set on
stopping Mamdani because they know his victory would be a seismic win for
working people and the progressive movement nationwide.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32997?source=email-20250728&t=1061&akid=9090%2E5885482%2EbeHFbJ ]Headline: Sanders says billionaire effort to crush Mamdani rooted in
fears of nationwide progressive wave

Which is why Our Revolution is going ALL IN to elect him – mobilizing
volunteers in all five boroughs, deploying crowd canvassers at transit
centers, busy streets, and shopping plazas, and making THOUSANDS of texts
and calls.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32783?t=1057&amount=22&amounts=9%2C22%2C27%2C46%2C66&refcode=email-20250728nd&firstname=Peter%20Willis&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&akid=9090%2E5885482%2EbeHFbJ ]Will you donate right now to fund our push to elect Zohran Mamdani as
Mayor of New York City? Every dollar you give immediately fuels direct
action on the ground as the election nears.

If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation to Our Revolution will process immediately.

A Mamdani victory could usher in the progressive wave we need to finally
shake MAGA’s hold on our political system. But the opposition is pouring
in from every direction. Trump has mobilized his right-wing machine and
billionaire-funded Super PACs against Mamdani. AIPAC is flooding the race
with dark money. And establishment Democrats are closing ranks to try to
block us.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32997?source=email-20250728&t=1060&akid=9090%2E5885482%2EbeHFbJ ]Headline: Mamdani victory could represent expansion of the Left's
influence

We know how to fight back. During the Democratic primary, Our Revolution
volunteers fanned out across all five boroughs on a mission. Our
organizers distributed massive amounts of literature on Mamdani’s plan to
make NYC livable, affordable, and accountable. And on election day, our
team was on the ground with Jamaal Bowman, going door-to-door and
street-to-street, having crucial conversations about why Mamdani is his
candidate.

It worked. Because we know that we win when neighbors persuade neighbors.
But to keep going – and to make every undecided New Yorker a confirmed
Mamdani voter – we need your support.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/32783?t=1054&amount=22&refcode=email-20250728nd&amounts=9%2C22%2C27%2C46%2C66&firstname=Peter%20Willis&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&akid=9090%2E5885482%2EbeHFbJ ]Our Revolution is all-in. But we need your help to double our impact, go
citywide, and reach every key voter we can. Will you chip in $7, $27, or
whatever you can afford to fuel the fight for Mamdani and for the
progressive future we all deserve?

This campaign isn’t about big donors. It’s about real grassroots energy.
Because the only way to face down Trump’s money machine, AIPAC’s millions,
and establishment insiders is to flood the streets with volunteers and
truth.

Thank you for believing in this movement – and for making victory
possible, together.

When we organize, we win.

**" Texas lawmakers head to flood-ravaged Kerrville this week for special session," **Houston Chronicle's**Jarrod Wardwell** -- "The Texas Legislature's special session will journey west to Kerrville this week, sending lawmakers to the seat of the most devastated county of the July 4 floods.

The two special committees weighing the legislative response to one of the deadliest flooding events in state history are [expected to travel to the Hill Country this week](https://substack.com/redirect/ce70ed7c-a44d-4ee1-9bf2-f306babe5ad3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and allow local residents to testify in Kerrville Thursday, [the Chronicle previously reported](https://substack.com/redirect/cb19a431-0b50-4995-bbb1-d979b969da6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Their visit from Austin would come during the second week of the legislature's special session, which kicked off last Monday and will last until Aug. 19.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/1925988e-b3ce-4fde-8a71-74603b1900d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Two people [were still missing](https://substack.com/redirect/69f94420-90d5-421c-a855-bf1e185c8882?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and 108 people were confirmed dead as of Monday morning in Kerr County as a result of the early-morning July 4 floods. The statewide death toll stood at 136.

The July 4 floods are one of the major subjects of the session, [alongside a THC ban](https://substack.com/redirect/6017c20d-3042-41f7-86ce-de209b6ce6dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and a [congressional redistricting plan](https://substack.com/redirect/f1b50c9c-7c45-4aff-9929-677c06fc5287?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Gov. **Greg Abbott** has asked lawmakers to consider flooding-related legislation under four categories -- flood warning systems, flood emergency communications, relief funding and disaster preparedness and recovery.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/1925988e-b3ce-4fde-8a71-74603b1900d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So far during the special session, Texas' emergency management chief has said Texas [needed better coordination](https://substack.com/redirect/cb19a431-0b50-4995-bbb1-d979b969da6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between state and local authorities during the July 4 flooding, and lawmakers have [blasted Kerr County's river authority](https://substack.com/redirect/c35dec64-9e7a-438a-b5b6-f37cb6b3fd1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for cutting property taxes instead of modernizing its flood warning system.

Some of the proposed flood-related measures in the legislature include physical flood sirens, radar-based monitoring that delivers instant alerts, a disaster preparedness council, and legislation, [which Abbott vetoed in 2019](https://substack.com/redirect/66270191-1089-4be2-a9b5-3b254c535e00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), allowing the public to sign up for local emergency alerts when they obtain or renew a driver's license." * **TOP NEWS**

**" Texas lawmakers head to flood-ravaged Kerrville this week for special session," **Houston Chronicle's**Jarrod Wardwell** -- "The Texas Legislature's special session will journey west to Kerrville this week, sending lawmakers to the seat of the most devastated county of the July 4 floods.

The two special committees weighing the legislative response to one of the deadliest flooding events in state history are [expected to travel to the Hill Country this week](https://substack.com/redirect/ac75fffd-3f17-4ea1-9803-84dc2a2e2aa1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and allow local residents to testify in Kerrville Thursday, [the Chronicle previously reported](https://substack.com/redirect/f2181a96-9c1b-49db-8129-770e5d65d0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Their visit from Austin would come during the second week of the legislature's special session, which kicked off last Monday and will last until Aug. 19.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c22d0c-1ba7-4235-a46c-88e78eaa2ae5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Two people [were still missing](https://substack.com/redirect/b9501eaf-3b67-4343-99e8-0ea5f8f54401?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and 108 people were confirmed dead as of Monday morning in Kerr County as a result of the early-morning July 4 floods. The statewide death toll stood at 136.

The July 4 floods are one of the major subjects of the session, [alongside a THC ban](https://substack.com/redirect/da213536-d369-4ea8-bf54-3b843d24f076?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and a [congressional redistricting plan](https://substack.com/redirect/c02ae833-949d-4aa7-b2af-ddff1e793b01?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Gov. **Greg Abbott** has asked lawmakers to consider flooding-related legislation under four categories -- flood warning systems, flood emergency communications, relief funding and disaster preparedness and recovery.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER HERE: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c22d0c-1ba7-4235-a46c-88e78eaa2ae5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So far during the special session, Texas' emergency management chief has said Texas [needed better coordination](https://substack.com/redirect/f2181a96-9c1b-49db-8129-770e5d65d0f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between state and local authorities during the July 4 flooding, and lawmakers have [blasted Kerr County's river authority](https://substack.com/redirect/d1811906-2b1f-49ec-9f95-cbd098fea325?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for cutting property taxes instead of modernizing its flood warning system.

Some of the proposed flood-related measures in the legislature include physical flood sirens, radar-based monitoring that delivers instant alerts, a disaster preparedness council, and legislation, [which Abbott vetoed in 2019](https://substack.com/redirect/31132b29-b78a-4bac-8e30-08d450e1912b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), allowing the public to sign up for local emergency alerts when they obtain or renew a driver's license." [Hou Chron](https://substack.com/redirect/d198d029-eb1a-4539-8762-abb3005e12dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1rld1n40tjatdbrmr68qv1qcf56a17h8tsewnx9zapkfw7r7673tsl2wono7olnp1vfsvag44zbtmrnvb6r84r1p9i564zty004napmd52qnadsy9o4e7wefatilwnqbrm7oofh8fd&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04jis&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04jis&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Peter,

Over the past few months, I've been fighting for the priorities the people of WA-08 care most about, and frankly: It's been extraordinarily frustrating trying to do anything under Republican leadership.

While I've been focused on real solutions for WA-08— _like the bipartisan Hydropower Relicensing Transparency Act Bill I just got passed to speed up clean energy projects and secure funding for safer roads and clean water, or the work I did to call out RFK Jr.'s dangerous conspiracies, and even my efforts to protect healthcare for working families and seniors_**—Speaker Mike Johnson and the Trump-loyal, GOP-controlled Congress have been hell-bent on doing the exact opposite.**

Speaker Johnson and far-right Republicans just passed Trump's request to take away over **$9 BILLION** in already approved federal funding for disaster relief, refugee support, and public broadcasting like _NPR,_ _PBS,_ and over 1,500 local TV and radio stations that are particularly critical in rural areas.

Peter: As your elected officials, **we made a promise to the American people when we passed a budget back in March that helped fund Public Broadcasting.** And extremists just broke that promise in order to curry favor with President Trump and the special interests that support their campaigns.

I'm doing everything I can in Congress to keep the government working for the people of WA-08. But to end House Republicans' unprecedented, line-crossing, hyper-partisan leadership, we need to win back the House in 2026—and we can’t do it without protecting the most vulnerable districts in Congress, like this one.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: I’m running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4]
Hi, Peter,
I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I’ve had enough.
We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and The Real Texas PAC to get us started off strong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-cooper?refcode=072725_4]
These are no ordinary times, Peter . I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
Washington can look like this, too. It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you, Peter .
We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have The Real Texas's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and The Real Texas today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-georgia?refcode=072725_4]

Let’s do this together,
Roy Cooper

body:
Peter,

This week, I joined 19 other attorneys general in suing the Trump administration over deeply cruel and unlawful new restrictions that would block people from basic public services.

These rules force states to check immigration status before offering a person help—even in life-threatening situations. That means delaying access to homeless shelters, mental health support, or basic medical care.

This is wrong—morally, legally, and practically.

Essential services like Head Start, community health centers, and mental health programs are already stretched to the limit. These new restrictions, imposed without warning or public input, would push many of them to the breaking point.

If someone is down on their luck and sleeping in the streets during a Minnesota winter, the right thing to do is to help them get to a shelter. Forcing programs to delay that aid can make the difference between life and death.

I’m taking the Trump administration to court to stop this cruelty and protect the people who rely on these vital services. But I can’t do it alone. I need your help to raise $25,000 before our end-of-month deadline.

According to our records, you’re still eligible for Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program. That means you can donate up to $75 (or $150 for couples) and get a full refund from the state.

body:
[ https://act.robbonta.com/go/4?refcode=em250728&t=1001&akid=1896%2E1088799%2EX0-n75 ]Rob Bonta

Trump is weaponizing private and
sensitive personal information.

Here’s what’s happening:

When families apply for food assistance from Supplemental Nutrition
Assistance Program (SNAP), they provide personal data on the understanding
that their information won’t be used for unrelated purposes — an
understanding backed by long-standing state and federal laws.

Now, the USDA is demanding that states turn over that personal data to the
federal government — and threatening loss of SNAP funding if they don’t
comply. In California alone, we’re talking about $1 billion a year that
helps families buy groceries and put food on the table.

This is illegal, plain and simple — so I’m suing. [ https://act.robbonta.com/survey/em-250728-pet/?t=1002&akid=1896%2E1088799%2EX0-n75 ]If you’re with me,
please sign my petition today.

ADD YOUR NAME

The idea that states would be forced to choose between protecting people’s
privacy or helping them feed their families is despicable.

And let’s be clear: the reason the Trump administration’s USDA is
demanding this data isn’t to root out waste or fraud — it’s to create a
culture of fear.

If you can’t trust that your personal information will be kept private,
you may well be unwilling to apply for essential services — even things
like school lunches for your kids.

The rules are simple — federal and state privacy laws make it illegal to
demand this kind of data sharing — and Trump doesn’t get to unilaterally
change those rules, no matter how much he wants to.

California will not comply with this illegal bait and switch — and we’ll
see the President in court.

[ https://act.robbonta.com/survey/em-250728-pet/?t=1003&akid=1896%2E1088799%2EX0-n75 ]If you agree that Trump needs to be held accountable for his blatant
and continuing violations of the law and the U.S. Constitution, please add
your name to stand with me today.

Thanks for speaking out with me.

-Rob

A little over a year ago, Joe Biden dropped out of the race for President of the United States, and Kamala Harris began her rapid ascent to the top of the political world.

Kamala Harris was woefully unprepared to be her party's standard-bearer, and luckily for you and me, America thought so, too. **As a former Navy SEAL, I've dodged my fair share of bullets, so believe me when I tell you that as a nation, we've never dodged a bigger bullet than Kamala Harris.**
