clean_body: You’re invited to a special livestream event where we’ll break down the Big Betrayal Bill – and plan our path forward. Peter, Tens of thousands of families came together on Saturday for inspiring Families First Mobilizations across the country – showing massive opposition to Republicans’ budget bill that sacrifices healthcare for millions in order to fund billionaire tax cuts and ICE deportations and detentions that are terrorizing our communities. Together, we stood up for the livelihoods of domestic workers and brought families and care workers impacted by the cuts together to show Congress that we won’t stop fighting for healthcare, care workers, and our communities. But we’re just getting started. Care in Action is proud to co-sponsor a powerful livestream event THIS WEDNESDAY, July 30, alongside national and local partners, to bring our communities together to unpack the devastating bill – and organize to fight back. All our communities are going to feel the deadly consequences of Republicans’ largest health care cuts in history. Care workers will lose their jobs and their health care, millions will have their coverage ripped away, and health care costs will increase for everyone. This livestream marks the 60th anniversary of Medicaid and Medicare on July 30th – and is a chance to hear directly from movement leaders, impacted people, union organizers, and elected officials such as Senator Sanders and Representative Jayapal about what’s in the bill, who is responsible for the harm it will cause, and what we must do next to fight forward. It will feature speakers from across our networks and a performance by Taina Asili and Pauline Pisano, and will ensure our communities have the resources we need to keep fighting by sharing toolkits and actions to take now and later. This is about more than one bill – it’s about standing together to fight for our future. We hope you’ll join us on Wednesday to kick off the next phase of this fight. As always, thanks for all you do, The Care in Action Team

clean_body: I’m excited to introduce you to North Carolina’s former Governor, Roy Cooper, who just launched his campaign to be the state’s next U.S. Senator. | | | | I'm excited to introduce you to North Carolina's former Governor, Roy Cooper, who just launched his campaign to be the state's next U.S. Senator. Roy is a proven fighter for working families, public education, and affordable health care, and if we're going to flip the Senate majority, winning this seat in North Carolina is absolutely critical. Roy knows how to win tough races. He's won statewide twice as governor — both times in years North Carolina also voted for Trump for president. We know the stakes: Republicans are attacking our freedoms, dismantling essential programs, and stacking the deck for billionaires while hardworking Americans struggle to get by. Roy's leadership can help change that. = Onward! Jeff Hello, I'm Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what's broken in Washington. Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I've had enough. = = These are no ordinary times. I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don't seem to share that sense of duty. When I look at what's happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires' pockets. They're cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe. They're punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give. There's another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people. Washington can look like this, too. It's time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve. Dear Friend,
We talk a lot about what’s at stake in Arizona: our economy, our schools, our healthcare, our clean water. But today, we want to talk about how we win.
It starts with people—field organizers who live in our communities, talk to voters face to face, and build the relationships that turn out votes.
And here's the truth: $10 a month could help hire one of them.
Here’s how your donation [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/azd-em-q3-2025?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=90d-act&utm_campaign=hire-field-organizer&utm_id=donation-breakdown&utm_content=2025-07-28] gets to work:
$10 fuels a day of canvassing in rural Arizona
$25 prints lit for 200 households
$50 covers a tank of gas to knock doors in underserved areas
$100 helps us recruit and train a new field organizer
$250 supports one week of voter outreach in a swing district
Every organizer we hire is one more person reaching voters, listening to concerns, and moving us toward a better future. That’s the kind of investment that pays off in turnout, in representation, and in real change.
Will you chip in today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/azd-em-q3-2025?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=90d-act&utm_campaign=hire-field-organizer&utm_id=donation-breakdown&utm_content=2025-07-28] and help build the team we need to win in 2026?

Let's build this together.

body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1rlfan9asw56ur02d0bf9chrrgo3tjs8x30kzbsc70440bcx66582v9y9oihii26tp4s30o1tuu7ov2fjkad6aj6pf79prmexdqsihkp6rf44bsqgbtldxus985apsciqkhehprz17&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1rlfan9asw56ur02d0bf9chrrgo3tjs8x30kzbsc70440bcx66582v9y9oihii26tp4s30o1tuu7ov2fjkad6aj6pf79prmexdqsihkp6rf44bsqgbtldxus985apsciqkhehprz17&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t04obg&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

We can’t take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip. Here’s something you may not know about me: **I’ve already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina.** I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state. NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we’ve proven together that Democrats can win. We know what we have to do. As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care _more_ affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I’ll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy. **I will not back down. I refuse to let Republicans in Washington take this country backward.** [**_I have never taken running for office lightly, and I know that winning this race won’t be easy. clean_body: I’m ready to serve again. = With great humility and endless hope for the future of America, I have an announcement to make: I am running for U.S. Senate. I’m Roy Cooper. I had the honor of serving North Carolina as Attorney General and Governor. = Democrats’ best hope of stopping the chaos in Washington is to retake the Senate in 2026, and our race here in NC is set to be the most competitive election next year. We can’t take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip. Here’s something you may not know about me: I’ve already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina. I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state. NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we’ve proven together that Democrats can win. We know what we have to do. As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care more affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I’ll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy. I will not back down. I refuse to let Republicans in Washington take this country backward. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be split between Kirsten Gillibrand and Roy Cooper immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you for being with me, Roy Cooper * =

That’s a political stunt, plain and simple. And it’s exactly what Americans hate about politics. Trump is once again trying to weaponize the Justice Department against his political opponents. This time, he’s not even hiding it. This is the same playbook we’ve seen from authoritarians around the world. We cannot let this become the new normal. We need leaders who tell the truth and stand up for our democracy — not tear it down for personal gain. Thanks for speaking out with me, – Josh *

name: Costello for U.S. Senate
subject: The Candidate with the Background and Experience to Defeat Senator Susan Collins in 2026
body:
Maine Democrats would do well to nominate a candidate whose personal story presents a significant contrast to that of Senator Collins.

| | | | | [|
---](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=64dcdf6add&e=5d7176e969)
| | | | | Friends,
To defeat Senator Susan Collins in 2026, Maine Democrats would do well tonominate a candidate whose personal story presents a significant contrast to thatof Senator Collins. The daughter of a well-connected and wealthy AroostookCounty business family, who has excelled as a politician but has accomplishedlittle of substance beyond electoral success in her 28 plus years as a U.S.Senator.
An ideal candidate is one that Maine’s middle-and-working class communitiesand families could readily identify with. A candidate who’s committed to fixinga broken Washington and ensuring that all Mainers, not just the wealthy, areprovided with the education, job skills, healthcare, and other life enrichingopportunities to thrive. A reform minded candidate with an extensive publicservice record who has worked his/her way up by getting important work done.Someone like David, who was born in Bangor and raised in Old Town by hismother and mill working grandparents following the early death of his Armyveteran and labor organizing father.
David, whose family was not well-off and who, like many in Maine, beganwork early and worked his way through the University of Maine, GeorgeWashington University, and the London School of Economics. And who servedfor more more than 30 years in senior-level government and non-governmentpositions, both in the United States, including in Maine, and abroad –implementing and managing; not simply legislating or talking about complexmulti-million-dollar programs and operations.
Programs and operations that included working closely with U.S. Army, theUnited Nations, and foreign aid organizations overseas – and various state andlocal government agencies, businesses, and non-governmental organizations inMaine, Maryland, and elsewhere.
Programs and operations that resulted in elections, campaign finance, and motorvehicle safety reforms in Maine; improved public schools and expandedassistance to children, youth and families at risk in Baltimore; theimplementation of ambitious job creation, education, healthcare, crimereduction, and environmental protection programs in Maryland; and foreignoperations that resulted in the completion of more than 4,000 peace andcommunity building projects in conflict-torn Cambodia, Haiti, Bosnia, Croatia,Kosovo, and Serbia. The contrasts between Senator Collin’s and David’s backgrounds and publicservice records couldn’t be starker, and the decision regarding whom to supportin 2026 should be an easy one.
If you agree, please share this email with others and consider a small donationto help in our efforts to defeat Senator Collins in 2026 and begin the hard workof fixing our imperfect and terribly broken federal government. Sincerely,Team Costello

| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

body:
The White House is not being truthful with the American people
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1739%2E791427%2Equg_oV)

**[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july25-epstein/?source=em250728-1-180&akid=1739%2E791427%2Equg_oV)
Friend — This month the House Rules Committee voted on a bill that would force the release of the federal files around the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein.
**Every Democrat voted yes._Every Republican voted no._**
And to keep Democrats from continuing to put Republicans on record defending pedophiles, Mike Johnson decided to shut down the House for over a month.
**[This is unacceptable and a clear sign that the White House is not being truthful with the American people. Please, sign on to my petition calling for the release of the Epstein files and a full accounting of whoever is trying to cover this up.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july25-epstein/?source=em250728-1-180&akid=1739%2E791427%2Equg_oV)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july25-epstein/?source=em250728-1-180&akid=1739%2E791427%2Equg_oV)**
Let’s address the GOP elephant in the room: Donald Trump is in these files, and he’s doing everything he can to shift our attention away from them.
After more and more details emerged about the close relationship between Jeffrey Epstein and Donald Trump, The Wall Street Journal has now **confirmed** that Trump was informed by his own Justice Department that his name came up multiple times throughout the Epstein files.
That might explain why Trump’s DOJ and FBI talked a big game about releasing the files when they came into office, only to completely back down months later.
It may also explain why Trump is desperately trying to get Congress, the press, and even his own supporters to stop talking about the Epstein case.
**Trump wants us to move on. I refuse.**
The Epstein case shocks the conscience of all Americans regardless of political parties because it’s a story about how the rich and powerful use their wealth to try to get away with truly evil and criminal acts.
As a member of Congress, I have an obligation to bring the truth to light — and a Constitutional obligation to hold the President accountable for his involvement.
**[That’s why I’m hoping you’ll add your name to my petition today calling for Congress to continue to push for the release of the Epstein files. We have to keep up the pressure, especially now as new details continue to be revealed that implicate the President in this criminal scandal.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july25-epstein/?source=em250728-1-180&akid=1739%2E791427%2Equg_oV)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july25-epstein/?source=em250728-1-180&akid=1739%2E791427%2Equg_oV)**
Thank you in advance for signing on and doing your part to seek accountability.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

body:
Here’s why we need to win this seat.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2603%2E4032634%2ESQ0aug)
---
It’s easy to feel defeated these days with the policies coming out of Washington nearly every day. Pickpocketing the middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. Cutting critical jobs at agencies that keep our country running. Destroying cornerstones of the middle class like Social Security, Medicaid, and public education. You and I know there’s another path. But it’s going to require fighting back, and taking back our Senate majority. **Just today, Roy Cooper announced he’s running for Senate in North Carolina — in what will be a highly competitive race.** Under his leadership as governor, Roy passed pay raises for public school teachers, built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and in North Carolinians, and expanded Medicaid — covering more than 650,000 more people. Put simply: He’s the kind of leader working families need in Washington right now. [**North Carolina will be a must-win state for Democrats. So will you split a donation today between our campaign and Roy Cooper’s to ensure his campaign launches with the strongest support possible? Your support will fuel our fight to take back our Senate majority in 2026.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3067?t=8&akid=2603%2E4032634%2ESQ0aug)

body:
| | | Peter, Summer is heating up — and so is the fight for working families. **Keep reading for the biggest moments from this month, including how we’re organizing protests, launching campaigns, and winning at the ballot box:**
* * *
**_TRUMP MEGABILL: THEY REALLY DID IT_** Despite months of organizing and protesting — and repeated promises from Republicans in Congress and Trump that Medicaid wouldn’t be touched — **Republicans passed the largest healthcare cuts in history, slashing more than $1 trillion from Medicaid funding.** Working Families Power, along with MoveOn and other allies, spent the final week running phonebanks every night, with thousands of volunteers reaching out to Medicaid recipients in key districts, urging them to call their lawmakers to oppose the bill. But GOP lawmakers ignored their constituents and passed it anyway. After the bill’s passage, WFP announced plans to back challengers to Republicans who sided with billionaires over working people: _“We deserve leaders who will fight for us — not obey the commands of their wealthiest donors. That’s why this month the Working Families Party will be announcing its backing of challengers to the GOP frauds who betrayed their communities by voting for this bill.”_ **But this fight is far from over, Peter.** While Republicans sold out their communities to serve their billionaire backers, we’re doing what we’ve always done: organizing, mobilizing, and building real power from the ground up. **WFP organizers and volunteers are already out there — at doors, in streets, and in neighborhoods — refusing to back down and fighting for the future we all deserve.** **[Chip in now to help us hold the GOP accountable and build the political power working people need to win.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9Iz5zZaRhQj465-IQb4RWWfRA8yraD8_QcP4R71s4YUkAINJ5EgoPlx-p2QozYMnkux1ZncRMFj35Sp-OnWW-pUVPYpChriaZ1lv8wTu-WN4OttGol2yXquJS8cb_88GtIyRNc696QxUnNUPPdfEOz6oGkhUAJ-TBV1AiYQ1F7M8qyRZDzBn3wpLvHfyTlhcCYNv3MbPRFl9zVSWy-_Uz5LMSvqPXbW2LUq4aw_aaxgKKAgdyXBh5Y9DGvleBS-2d8Ak1zZI4QfVwPeZ_xMURGb86fqe_FMMYsFcUFK1chU-nfWH7Afvx2NYHNFF2kdQgNQuPWqkba-eS2mzyrwsMpJCjN5Uc8sOGisk8g849Sxw/4ik/vhP9VjWmRlGJcSQD3mFfIg/h0/h001.tWRL5uE674d73x_zrDVEOYJOAdNAL97pF1daoe_52W0)**

* * *
_**2026 IS ALREADY HERE: MEET OUR FIRST TWO HOUSE CHALLENGERS** _ The GOP’s vote to slash Medicaid won’t go unanswered, Peter — we’re building campaigns right now to unseat the politicians who betrayed their constituents. This month, we’re proud to have endorsed our first two Working Families Party candidates for Congress in 2026, both running to defeat Republicans who voted to rip healthcare away from millions.
* **In Colorado’s 8th District, Amie Baca-Oehlert** is taking on GOP Rep. Gabe Evans, who barely won his last race. A teacher, mother, and former president of the Colorado Education Association, Amie has spent her life fighting for working families — and she’s ready to do the same in Congress.
* **In California’s 22nd District, Randy Villegas** is challenging Rep. David Valadao — who promised to protect Medicaid, then voted for its destruction. Randy’s a school board trustee, educator, and son of immigrants, running a people-powered campaign that’s already raised over $231,000 from 3,300 grassroots donors — no corporate PAC money, ever.

[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9n1Km6AUy1Et3nokC5J0Qgl_LebGg9F5GGTWx-ZJPklOG3bvKXQoEoDBG_81uJa0JT20FmC6gb-v1R4lz3hnp9c59H3j6N4qeR5KmZCcfhyQliHzqYzGtmw22dhVtYOqeeNmkQ4FQS3NsUDc7234S5wFc_gzbF8L99wbHI3u0Dykl57UZcA9w7Y6hRmdXDQvPCCXoR56D3YmVcoaKvITyiGMr6b89zrkiMGHwYapsfOlltS0ZjQHCPb1Vt9QWDUy5e1dPrK8VPOwLr3TRtjdZVcIpx3VA2yROpARM-HQOL7dptGhpltIy4jiLvkbBDIE08KIK_3a-SBjd-jVzQvBsiIejM_KwI4W1N3z3mYuceeY/4ik/vhP9VjWmRlGJcSQD3mFfIg/h1/h001.LclM9F5-wjToiJoY8BV-Aq0ila-WRX7Di_xDygAZ1W0)These aren’t long-shot campaigns. They’re the real deal — serious contenders with deep community roots, working-class values, and momentum on their side. [**Help us build early momentum in 2026 — split a donation between Amie and Randy today.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9n1Km6AUy1Et3nokC5J0Qgl_LebGg9F5GGTWx-ZJPklOG3bvKXQoEoDBG_81uJa0J1ssvl4v6xLTC_1BPnrl3JjGQt4I5zFROr0KEyJPPJfBTXNjL7q070gWiaZl0BF6v7sfe5fD9WzOFaVVe8jFMUjrqk9eFBg3J3PoMpb4zRha3rwMkgtvt80RDPq8baVXWgtVrnJBkBrFsNU_ZZt5hB9uWkBKZGQRkq1HHvR0h53_ZwT-TxaHhPamZ0dEfZWkLt5e2cuqoKg5G0Zi6piCjgRnkhyw7FF1ME8mDiNms6h7k2WgVrgUSIdGw9VCnXuudmJZ_YqyrnIiYStFktYIJHU4dWxAo9dJxcydGPXT_WvQ/4ik/vhP9VjWmRlGJcSQD3mFfIg/h2/h001.CBxE53mNGQTPPbs-rTOJEqGdew_R7q_aisBgv_iuWIQ)
* * *
**_ADELITA GRIJALVA WINS ARIZONA SPECIAL ELECTION PRIMARY FOR CONGRESS_** In Arizona’s 7th District, WFP champion Adelita Grijalva just crushed her primary with 62% of the vote — the first big win of the _2026_ cycle. **[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9Iz5zZaRhQj465-IQb4RWWfRA8yraD8_QcP4R71s4YUkAINJ5EgoPlx-p2QozYMnkPs2Sle3lMASLZTZdQhmtujWya5AxogQmzA0vcTmyyY3LYgI8WvXKIidMfuqkR_lbD5PDJ8NnnzUQ1ZjDEpj0krTQyi2esxjbu8L1WEutrbvWycDYTEEPmqj9gOhvNTff3IexE3btAT4wVsBAofaDlH8TRwEMyuYJ6FajEAF6FzG7jUhrHvt1Lkqfhy8XFoqjJvRg3mYFCkmJqg0jVdzQ1ZFQyM9Ex0O3UZYGTwSFnKL0dsoN3F62v41V2OiEK6iW0lyood8XMMzqhVMZtsw_bS6I8CY0YXcHOwuY1rIi2xc/4ik/vhP9VjWmRlGJcSQD3mFfIg/h3/h001.CMeLY3RyDdouZ9pNhHw40ooDH3tnb-OQuIyj8v5C-hI)** As a Pima County Supervisor, Adelita delivered real results: free preschool for low-income families, bold investments in climate resiliency, and affordable housing. **_A STINKY SITUATION IN PHILLY_** When Philadelphia’s municipal workers, members of AFSCME DC 33, launched an eight-day strike for a fair contract, the city came to a standstill. Trash piled up — quickly dubbed “Parker Piles” — and essential services were disrupted. Their message was simple: i**n a city that just voted to give more tax breaks to wealthy corporations, working-class employees deserve fair pay and dignity.** AFSCME DC 33 is the _lowest-paid_ of Philly’s four municipal unions, and the only one with a majority-Black membership. Most members earn less than a living wage — even as they keep the city running. clean_body: | | | Peter, Summer is heating up — and so is the fight for working families. Keep reading for the biggest moments from this month, including how we’re organizing protests, launching campaigns, and winning at the ballot box: TRUMP MEGABILL: THEY REALLY DID IT Despite months of organizing and protesting — and repeated promises from Republicans in Congress and Trump that Medicaid wouldn’t be touched — Republicans passed the largest healthcare cuts in history, slashing more than $1 trillion from Medicaid funding. Working Families Power, along with MoveOn and other allies, spent the final week running phonebanks every night, with thousands of volunteers reaching out to Medicaid recipients in key districts, urging them to call their lawmakers to oppose the bill. But GOP lawmakers ignored their constituents and passed it anyway. After the bill’s passage, WFP announced plans to back challengers to Republicans who sided with billionaires over working people: “We deserve leaders who will fight for us — not obey the commands of their wealthiest donors. That’s why this month the Working Families Party will be announcing its backing of challengers to the GOP frauds who betrayed their communities by voting for this bill.” But this fight is far from over, Peter. While Republicans sold out their communities to serve their billionaire backers, we’re doing what we’ve always done: organizing, mobilizing, and building real power from the ground up. WFP organizers and volunteers are already out there — at doors, in streets, and in neighborhoods — refusing to back down and fighting for the future we all deserve. 2026 IS ALREADY HERE: MEET OUR FIRST TWO HOUSE CHALLENGERS The GOP’s vote to slash Medicaid won’t go unanswered, Peter — we’re building campaigns right now to unseat the politicians who betrayed their constituents. This month, we’re proud to have endorsed our first two Working Families Party candidates for Congress in 2026, both running to defeat Republicans who voted to rip healthcare away from millions. In Colorado’s 8th District, Amie Baca-Oehlert is taking on GOP Rep. Gabe Evans, who barely won his last race. A teacher, mother, and former president of the Colorado Education Association, Amie has spent her life fighting for working families — and she’s ready to do the same in Congress. In California’s 22nd District, Randy Villegas is challenging Rep. David Valadao — who promised to protect Medicaid, then voted for its destruction. Randy’s a school board trustee, educator, and son of immigrants, running a people-powered campaign that’s already raised over $231,000 from 3,300 grassroots donors — no corporate PAC money, ever. aren’t long-shot campaigns. They’re the real deal — serious contenders with deep community roots, working-class values, and momentum on their side. ADELITA GRIJALVA WINS ARIZONA SPECIAL ELECTION PRIMARY FOR CONGRESS In Arizona’s 7th District, WFP champion Adelita Grijalva just crushed her primary with 62% of the vote — the first big win of the 2026 cycle. As a Pima County Supervisor, Adelita delivered real results: free preschool for low-income families, bold investments in climate resiliency, and affordable housing. Her opponent? A pro-corporate former legislator who barely scraped 14%. With support from LUCHA, Worker Power, and Our Voice Our Vote, we knocked on over 90,000 doors. We also invested $200,000 in targeted ads and voter outreach — and it paid off. As Adelita said to on election night: this victory belongs to the movement. She’s expected to win the general election this September — and this is just the beginning. ONWARD TO NOVEMBER IN NYC: A WORKING FAMILIES PARTY VICTORY Last month, Zohran Mamdani won the Democratic primary for NYC Mayor in a landslide — defeating disgraced ex-Gov. Andrew Cuomo and his billionaire backers. , this wasn’t just a win — it was a mandate. Or just “Now it’s a Working Families Party party,” live on election night. The New York Working Families Party coordinated over 100 canvasses and events, ran , and aired national ads with AOC and Cynthia Nixon, completely reshaping the race. Starting from just 1% in the polls, Zohran’s rise to the top was historic. And it wasn’t a fluke — NY WFP also in Buffalo, Syracuse, and Albany. Hear NY WFP co-directors Ana María Archila and Jasmine Gripper break it all down on Plus, from WFP National PAC and New Yorkers for Lower Costs shows Zohran leading with 40% in the General Election, well ahead of Cuomo (24%), Adams (15%), and Silwa (14%). But the fight isn’t over. Billionaires are regrouping. Cuomo and right-wing forces are hunting for alliances. It’s going to take all of us to win in November. It’s time to organize, gear up, and fight to win in November. A STINKY SITUATION IN PHILLY When Philadelphia’s municipal workers, members of AFSCME DC 33, launched an eight-day strike for a fair contract, the city came to a standstill. Trash piled up — quickly dubbed “Parker Piles” — and essential services were disrupted. Their message was simple: in a city that just voted to give more tax breaks to wealthy corporations, working-class employees deserve fair pay and dignity. AFSCME DC 33 is the lowest-paid of Philly’s four municipal unions, and the only one with a majority-Black membership. Most members earn less than a living wage — even as they keep the city running. The Pennsylvania Working Families Party stood with AFSCME DC 33 every step of the way: organizing , raising for the strike fund, and joining picket lines. WFP Councilmember Kendra Brooks also spoke out — But instead of meeting the workers’ demands, Mayor Cherelle Parker’s administration tried to shut down the strike with court injunctions. And even with strong public support — from everyday Philadelphians to artists like LL Cool J and Jazmine Sullivan — the pressure wasn’t enough. The final contract fell short of the union’s demands and passed by a slim margin. We’re not backing down though. We’ll keep fighting to make Philly a city where every worker earns a living wage and has the resources to thrive. WATCH OUR VIDEO — GOOD TROUBLE: HONORING JOHN LEWIS' LEGACY W/ PARK CANNON On the anniversary of Congressman John Lewis’s passing, we honored his legacy the best way we know how — by continuing his fight. We released a new video featuring Georgia State Rep. Park Cannon, a WFP-endorsed leader, reflecting on Lewis’s call to make “good trouble,” and what that means today as Trump and his allies try to divide and distract us. It’s a powerful reminder that our strength lies in unity. And that together, we can defeat the government of billionaires and build one that truly serves all of us. NEW LOCAL ENDORSEMENTS IN MICHIGAN, GEORGIA, AND OHIO We’ve got new endorsements — and they’re the kind of leaders who’ve been doing the work long before they were on the ballot. 📍 Detroit, Michigan(Primary is Tuesday, August 5) Denzel McCampbell(for City Council, District 7) grew up in Detroit and has been organizing for clean water, voting rights, and affordable housing for years. He helped rewrite the city charter to hold power accountable — now he’s running to fight for working streetlights, tenant protections, and transit that actually works. Gabriela Santiago-Romero(for City Council, District 6) is a Mexican immigrant and lifelong organizer raised in Southwest Detroit. As the current incumbent in District 6, she’s secured $1M for street safety, expanded homeownership access, and continues to reject all corporate PAC money. Because she's fighting for her community — not special interests. 📍 Atlanta, Georigia Rohit Malhotra(for City Council president) is the son of immigrants and a nationally recognized civic leader. He’s spent his career helping cities center racial justice, public trust, and community-led solutions. Now he’s running for City Council President to flip the script — and build a city that works for everyone, not just the powerful. 📍 Dayton, Ohio Shenise Turner-Sloss(for Mayor) is a union member, public servant, and proven WFP champion. is a union member, public servant, and proven WFP champion. As City Commissioner, she’s delivered funding for youth programs, pushed for transparent budgets, and led the creation of Dayton’s first housing policy. Now, she’s ready to go even further as mayor. We’ll keep you up to date on virtual phone banking opportunities that will allow you to directly reach voters, to share with them what we’re fighting for and how they can help. Sign up to join the team here. Our next WFP National Welcome Gathering is Thursday, August 21st at 7:00 PM ET/4:00 PM PT! At the gathering, you can hear from WFP organizers who will share what we’re working on nationwide and any ways to get plugged in. If you’re feeling anxious about this political moment and the fight ahead, the Welcome Gathering is an opportunity to ground yourself in our shared values and community. We hope to see you there! RSVP here. Thanks for catching up with us, Peter! Right now, working families are getting crushed — Medicaid is being slashed, rents are soaring, and wages are stuck while billionaires keep getting richer. This isn’t just a fight to defend what we have left. It’s a fight to build a movement powerful enough to demand justice, win bold victories, and reclaim the future our communities deserve. Friend,
---
I was retained as President Trump’s lawyer shortly after he was wrongly accused of being a Russian agent.
---
Thank God the truth came out, and the President walked free.
---
But now we know the _full story_. Newly DECLASSIFIED evidence alleges that my former client was FRAMED...
---
Director of National Intelligence Report: “Declassified Evidence of Obama Administration Conspiracy to Subvert President Trump’s 2016 Victory and Presidency”
---
Imagine if they got away with it. Imagine if President Trump were sitting in prison as an innocent man – and not because of a mistake, but because of a _set-up_ ...
---
As a lifelong prosecutor, that makes me sick to my stomach.
---
I spent my career obsessing over one thing: ensuring those I prosecuted were _truly_ guilty. I NEVER wanted to look back and think I took away liberty from an innocent man – and God forbid, his _life_.
---
**But unfortunately, that may soon be __my own fate__.**
---
**A Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial as an innocent man for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
And the judge presiding over my case was appointed by _Obama’s_ former Homeland Security Secretary! _It’s rigged from start to finish!_
---
_Democrats couldn’t take down President Trump. So now, they’re calling for the head of the man who helped him walk free._
---
**The Left wants me to be their sacrificial lamb.**
---
_But I’m not going to roll over and surrender. I’m going to recall those powerful words of our President and _fight, fight, fight!__
---
While the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
**That’s why I’m humbly asking YOU to fight for my freedom and justice.**
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON”**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ec0088954cba41238d7fd2b1d2b4f0f2&_e=fxSrPPSpSg_hIHKvhmCSswcS3_5fEJawJ1syZwW5ojG7CENo_uiWo3J06jH263-JviD2CIy1GQcyi_u0GUov7BF20a2bEja4e4nlVDCCxj_Z8iP0tJsi_bwhxZVi7oTq1-mGywP5Ij9U28huI3szgDBUX8Hb7HTYgng_m2QLTpQOxdNsuuJx2T_E9qSBXWxzvL5mouxXZZC6lc5j4NSaLOikwowuI6R8r9tgeLII2ubB_CpEDLu9tyMjl1ekKhlovHETtGDQ4Kffi-0-81wWYuVsc_wosNUz8EPiG08HhZn2DW7LXEWFaNuTePw3myQvRO6fF4BZXAuwmVkC2G4ZbN7wxme0OUkGQs633g43kIJWI_FzCQ5MOmXj0QsnwV9q-s4Q-EWu1XvpY88DYp7fD3s9jmZmmpwwP72nR7NrIPfdw3K8Yt15DSj5zlSE4j2dWpNat-fYL9P7v9Ea2vat5Gnkkezyt5KftgEpqCSBO3AGQnzSEzN6O4XlvTCSlZC-M10hfDviyvLqxfn3ofDHhbMBdBf1eVK6FyAYkCet9M8wOqZ_WlEFbxMjDoomfkfVP_5HTePkz3AKWVJ8lpXVqn_JvFZZXpNo4r6ChBuQ2j6_Xl3TfZSFJBckXrecyyfShtjO921YDkJ0rQJNU1eN3Q%3D%3D)— calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.
---

body:
I’m ready to serve again.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92522?t=6&akid=20746%2E878179%2EUJ6wRJ) Hello, friend,

**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**

Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**

[We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $10 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to get us started off strong?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92522?t=7&akid=20746%2E878179%2EUJ6wRJ) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92522?t=8&akid=20746%2E878179%2EUJ6wRJ)

**These are no ordinary times, folks.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.

When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.

_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.

There’s another path, friend. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.

_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.

If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you.

[We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have the Voter Protection Project's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and the Voter Protection Project today.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/92522?t=9&akid=20746%2E878179%2EUJ6wRJ)

I hope you’ll believe me when I say: Donald Trump’s reckless tariffs are devastating our small business community.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112303933/560071518/1435897075?refcode=email_072825_tariffs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MGYyNjQ1MC1mZjZiLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_7CxrqE3ZpQ5Ir4mQnazz0sdyV6m7n-EoptbXOY2RLw=&emci=7084cdc8-4b63-f011-8dc9-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=40f26450-ff6b-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ceid=7280715) Folks, we turned around Colorado’s economy when I was Governor. And before that, I helped open our state’s very first brewpub: Wynkoop Brewing Company. So I hope you’ll believe me when I say: **Donald Trump’s reckless tariffs are devastating to our small business community.** Since Trump incited this senseless trade war, small businesses across the nation — who already operate on strict budgets and tight margins — have been frozen in their tracks. So they’ve been forced to make tough decisions — like laying off hardworking staff, cutting business hours, or raising prices — _just to get by._ It’s even been reported that U.S. employers could lose up to $82 BILLION due to Trump’s trade lunacy. And here in Colorado, our cherished breweries are facing higher costs on materials like steel or aluminum, and especially imported malts and hops. This means more expensive craft beers — _alongside so many other grocery price hikes_ — as manufacturing costs skyrocket. This is personal to me, folks. If I still ran Wynkoop today, there’s no doubt in my mind that Trump’s tariff-taxes would hit us hard. There’s no way in hell we would’ve risked buying a new brew kettle if we couldn’t predict how much our basic supplies would cost us just months down the line. And that’s the same calculation going through the heads of small business owners across Colorado.** The bottom line is, these reckless tariff-taxes are costing Coloradans dearly. Trump’s trade war is simply unsustainable, and it needs to end — now.** Folks, that’s why I’m running for re-election. With Trump in the White House ruling by fiat and pushing our economy towards a recession, it’s become that much more important that Democrats take back the Senate in 2026 to provide real oversight, and a real check on the president’s power. **[But if we lose here in Colorado, so goes our chances of retaking the majority to block Trump’s extreme agenda. | | Hello, **I'm Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what's broken in Washington.** Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I've had enough.** [**We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that's right for you between my campaign and Andy Kim****to get us started off strong?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112304194/560072314/1832796208?refcode=2025-07-28-kimcoopersplit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=5c13014b-006c-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzEzMDE0Yi0wMDZjLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q5xSZ2cp3Uo-Kh9XnrYW1GJqOc5Hwuv-RxuLJb67ok=) [Donate Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112304195/560072315/1832796208?refcode=2025-07-28-kimcoopersplit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=5c13014b-006c-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzEzMDE0Yi0wMDZjLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q5xSZ2cp3Uo-Kh9XnrYW1GJqOc5Hwuv-RxuLJb67ok=) **These are no ordinary times****.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don't seem to share that sense of duty. When I look at what's happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires' pockets. They're cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe. _They're punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give. There's another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. clean_body: I’m ready to serve again. | | | Hello, I'm Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what's broken in Washington. Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I've had enough. = = These are no ordinary times. I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don't seem to share that sense of duty. When I look at what's happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires' pockets. They're cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe. They're punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give. There's another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people. Washington can look like this, too. name: Crystal Cavalier & Jason Keck
subject: You're Invited: Rights of Nature Workshop – Stopping Fossil Fuels and Reframing Conservation through Indigenous & Community-Led Law
body:
Many Indigenous frameworks and Rights of Nature approaches challenge the separation between conservation and environmental protection, instead viewing land, water, air, and beings as interconnected relatives. | | | Dear Relatives, We are excited to invite you to an upcoming workshop at YESA Farm: **Rights of Nature: Reframing Conservation through Indigenous and Community-Led Law**
🗓 **Wednesday, October 22, 2025**
🕙 **10:00 AM – 2:00 PM**
📍 **YESA Farm, Pleasant Grove, NC** **[RSVP](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38T9-_UGTOTN-JIM4hWp15khHoD9PMZcwqQFk5p5UdBVSgrJ1uJl3kWhkUsEP3Qkz-ZeWm7ZQMti7_-RL8SQRwHgrIAY9iKJcqPnmknOVhFpjl1KDJoirimaOWFSSrDRDXRLp_4YVwWE3ebDWDZMPRh9MxRixhtR_34wGejZn_Uxg_x5_MGS6ciGMeCbBMq1ICx0eMYMoQepfsCMbaQh8U6BtFc-doPxaOc2erpGS1nAyAfeaZfVc2tjNsvfH8eTWSKckd4--FeotkyQwyJnL_hcyPhklJZp2CA29KIBOmbcXQF9_IQVGSFSLIjCf43K14GnYLENl1ni_rQ-k6ON0m1iROktDeOIOBV7cOIbTxqqqgtNhFIpGT8qMc-0bsu389SRW1AwyeE4Wn30Sgt34YDNcBYK-rTlcpLVbJVoTzajRrh_0OuRWywTDCaiuW11KJnCGj2Vsz73ExhwV8qNwoz4ffvwOKpU2R5t8t2iBSzFjD4SUHE7TJ60XTwXNURPUHilnK8h39QntHz2z4qOUTf9c95sGPsAPRccRbOiYfVQkBhp1nEIcZi005ZgNAcfF0/4ik/_daam3H_RXywartjn4ek5w/h0/h001.nUTciT2QQnWYZcoZMWMtyWI7dHsB5ZFyn3v9PYx67K8) Here** This interactive workshop introduces **the Rights of Nature (RoN)** as a robust framework for transforming conservation, one that centers on Indigenous land ethics, community-based legal tools, and views land as a living relative. It is especially designed for **North Carolina land trusts, conservancies, community land partners, and local government allies**. **Together, we will:**
🌱 Understand Rights of Nature as a legal, ethical, and cultural framework
🌍 Explore how RoN expands Western conservation through Indigenous worldviews
📖 Learn from real-world RoN applications—globally and here in North Carolina
🛠 Gain practical tools for integrating RoN into easements, stewardship, and advocacy
🤝 Identify new pathways for co-stewarding land rooted in reciprocity and justice This will be a hands-on, dialogue-rich experience that brings together diverse voices and perspectives. We hope you can join us in exploring how Rights of Nature can support deeper, more just relationships with the lands and waters we aim to protect. **Space is limited** , so RSVP by Monday, October 20, 2025. With gratitude,
Crystal Cavalier
🌾 YESA Farm | 7 Directions of Service

# Trump calls London mayor "nasty" during tense Scotland press conference
During a weekend visit to Scotland, **[President Donald Trump sparked awkward laughter](https://substack.com/redirect/cd5b2e9e-9772-4d6e-b582-da175affb774?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **by criticizing London Mayor Sadiq Khan while standing beside British Prime Minister Keir Starmer during a conference touching on many diplomatic developments.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/76854523-cf63-4089-a72e-5607dc51fab2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **When asked if he would visit London** during his state visit, Trump confirmed he would, but added, "I'm not a fan of your mayor ... a nasty person," referring to Khan. Starmer interrupted with a laugh, quickly defending Khan. "He's a friend of mine, actually."
* **Trump continued his criticism,** repeating that Khan had "done a terrible job" as mayor, while insisting he would still visit the British capital.
* **The joint appearance also highlighted Trump 's** announcement that he helped broker a ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand, saying he used a trade deal as leverage. "I said, 'I don't want to trade with anybody that's killing each other,'" Trump said.
* **Trump thanked Prime Minister Starmer** for backing the U.S. during the negotiations, saying, "Thank you to Keir," and noting the cooperation as part of broader diplomatic progress between the two allies.

# Maine liberals revolt against losing cheap illegal labor in ongoing protests
A group of residents in Wells, Maine have **[launched weekly protests](https://substack.com/redirect/333aa624-4d2f-4529-9a4b-1755956403df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** against the local police department's recent partnership with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), calling it a betrayal of the small coastal town's values and economy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/333aa624-4d2f-4529-9a4b-1755956403df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The agreement, signed March 28** by Police Chief Jo-Ann Putnam, makes Wells the only department in Maine to formally partner with ICE, allowing local officers to aid in immigration enforcement -- a role typically reserved for federal agents.
* **Demonstrators have lined U.S. Route 1** weekly since April with signs like "No ICE in our community" and "Fight ignorance, not immigrants." Protesters say the deal threatens the town's seasonal economy, which relies heavily on foreign workers staffing hotels and restaurants.
* **Chief Putnam defended the move,** calling it "another tool in the toolbox" to deal with "designated criminal aliens," and emphasized that Wells remains one of Maine's safest towns. She also said no officers have yet participated in any ICE operations.
* **Business leaders, including Maine State Chamber of Commerce** CEO Patrick Woodcock, warned the partnership could deter much-needed international workers. "We do need to ensure that those who are authorized to work feel welcomed," he said, citing recent economic decline in the state.

# Violent Cincinnati brawl sparks social media debate and investigation
Cincinnati police have launched an investigation into**[a violent street fight downtown](https://substack.com/redirect/ce528b53-946f-4a00-85da-21a05e4e69cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **after a graphic video of the incident circulated on social media late Friday.
* **The footage shows multiple people bloodied** and a woman apparently knocked unconscious, occurring near Elm and Fourth Streets. The incident was not reported to police until the video surfaced online, according to Fox19 NOW. Witnesses said the incident followed a verbal dispute involving an allegedly intoxicated man who left, then returned with others who escalated the situation and allegedly shouted slurs.
* **Several individuals exchange punches in the footage,** including a man striking another person to the ground. At least two people appear seriously injured. "Nothing short of cruel," is how Police Chief Teresa Theetge described the violence, adding the incident was unrelated to the nearby Cincinnati Music Festival.
* **Officials criticized both the attackers and bystanders.** State Rep. Cecil Thomas said the incident was "embarrassing," urging people to call 911 rather than record violent acts. Councilman Mark Jeffreys called the behavior "inhumane," and Councilman Seth Walsh said the video could damage downtown's public image. Fraternal Order of Police President Ken Kober condemned the crowd's lack of action.
* **Police are currently reviewing security footage,** interviewing witnesses, and collecting statements. Authorities have asked anyone with information to contact Crime Stoppers at 513-352-3040.

# Trump hammers Putin for peace deal, sharply reduces deadline
President Donald Trump criticized Russian President Vladimir Putin on Monday, **[reducing a peace deadline to just 10-12 days,](https://substack.com/redirect/bd742500-da89-48c9-b274-44c5a1c465f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** citing a lack of progress and a deadly new wave of Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bd742500-da89-48c9-b274-44c5a1c465f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Speaking from Scotland** alongside UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer, Trump said he was "very disappointed" in Putin and had lost patience after what he described as repeated broken promises. "I'm not so interested in talking anymore," Trump said. "We have such nice conversations...and then people die the following night."
* **Trump originally gave Putin a 50-day window** to reach a peace deal during a July 14 meeting with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte. After Russia launched more than 300 drones and missiles into Ukraine overnight -- some striking Kyiv and injuring at least five -- Trump said the deadline would now be closer to 10 days.
* **" I would have said five times we would have had a deal,"** Trump told reporters, expressing frustration over stalled talks. He pointed to recent attacks that left "bodies lying all over the street."
* **Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy** said Ukraine's air defenses shot down 309 of 324 drones and multiple missiles in the latest barrage. "Unfortunately, not all of them," Zelenskyy said, adding that discussions with allies would continue to strengthen Ukraine's air shield and domestic drone production.

# Liberal comedian admits he was DEAD WRONG about tariffs: "that's the fact!"
Comedian and longtime Donald Trump critic Bill Maher acknowledged on his _Club Random_ podcast Monday that **[he misjudged the economic impact of Trump's tariff policies,](https://substack.com/redirect/58fa2ab7-e7a7-41cd-bbd9-7371a54594bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** admitting that, despite his skepticism, the economy has not collapsed.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ee83403b-5ab4-4b43-9efb-ea45f51e21b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Speaking with progressive YouTuber Brian Tyler Cohen,** Maher said he once believed Trump's tariffs would tank the economy, but that prediction hasn't come true. "I would have thought, and I've got to own it, that these tariffs were going to f------ sink this economy by this time -- and they didn't," he said.
* **Maher emphasized "The stock market is at record highs**... I don't see a country in a depression at all. I see people just out there living their lives."
* **Cohen responded by cautioning against bold forecasts,** saying the tariff situation was part of why he stopped making predictions. "If I was good at predicting things, Hillary would have been the president in 2016," he joked.
* **Maher had previously criticized Trump 's trade tactics, **calling them "completely a-- backwards," and dismissed efforts to revive U.S. manufacturing as outdated. But with the economy showing resilience, and Trump securing a new 15% tariff deal with the EU, Maher acquiesced it's time to reassess: "Let's work first from the reality of that, not from 'I just hate Donald Trump.'"

name: Stasha Rhodes
subject: SCOTUS to ban having fun with friends on the sports field?
disclaimer_text: paid for by right-wing extremist culture warriors
body:
The Supreme Court no longer cares about democracy—it only cares about the culture war. | |
---
Peter, You can count the number of trans youth athletes in America on one hand. **Yet that’s who the Supreme Court has announced they’ll spend their next term attacking.** Hot off their _U.S. v Skrmetti_ decision stripping gender-affirming care from tens of thousands of trans youth, the MAGA justices on the Supreme Court are set to take up two cases ruling on state-level bans on transgender people participating in sports. That’s because the highest court in the land is no longer in the business of defending democracy. They’ve been bought and paid for by right-wing extremist culture warriors. **These transphobic activists swept the Supreme Court up in their manufactured moral panic. And rather than ruling based on science and Constitutional rights, the MAGA justices chose to give credence to the “sincere concerns” of bigots.** It wasn’t enough to make it nearly impossible for trans kids to access vital healthcare. The right-wing culture warriors are now targeting these kids’ ability to have fun with their friends on the sports field **This is supposed to be a democracy. The Supreme Court shouldn’t get to decide who gets to access healthcare and who gets to play on the high school soccer team. But this is the America MAGA has packed the courts to build.** When they decided _Skrmetti_ , the MAGA justices wrote that the case carries “fierce scientific and policy debates,” from those that “raise sincere concerns.” In other words, whether our kids get healthcare or are banned from playing with their friends is now up for legitimate debate because a few powerful bigots bought Supreme Court seats for their MAGA friends. **The upcoming cases on transgender athlete bans are just the next step in the right-wing attempt to exercise control over the rest of us. Today they’re coming after trans athletes—tomorrow they could turn their backwards moral panic on punishing gay teenagers, or stripping more rights away from women.** The MAGA Supreme Court is helping strip our democracy for parts little by little. But they don’t own us, our rights, or our Constitution. We do. [**We’re leading the fight to take back our democracy from those who have bought and paid to corrupt it. Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. I’ve had enough.

---
| |
---
| This legislation is a game-changer in the fight against the deadly fentanyl crisis that’s devastating our communities. It permanently classifies fentanyl-related substances as Schedule I drugs — the harshest penalties under federal law — and ensures law enforcement has the tools they need to get this poison off our streets. Let’s be clear: fentanyl is not just another drug. It’s a synthetic killer responsible for over 70,000 American deaths last year alone. And the cartels pushing it across our southern border don’t care if the victims are teens in small town Minnesota or parents in the heart of our cities. That’s why I took action. Because while some politicians are busy making excuses or playing political games, I’m focused on delivering real results by protecting our families, supporting law enforcement, and cracking down on the criminals fueling this crisis. Thank you for standing with me. Together, we can keep Minnesota safe and send a message: Enough is enough. Gratefully, Brad Finstad

As Fair Fight Founder Stacey Abrams puts it:
**"Many of us grew up with the stories of the civil rights movement and voter suppression of the '60s, guns and dogs and hoses...The voter suppression in the 21st century is administrative."**
This is _exactly_ what’s happening right now in Georgia.
The purge list consists of voters who are registered in Georgia and have been marked as inactive for various reasons — people who may have moved out of Georgia, out-of-state college students, members of the military, or even frequent, long-time Georgia voters who missed out on voting in any recent elections.
If a voter has been placed on the inactive list by the Georgia Secretary of State’s office, and does not contact their county office to be reactivated, they will be removed from the voter rolls by August 20th.

clean_body: More attacks on voting freedom are coming, and we need our grassroots movement to help fight back. | | | Hey Team, Right now , Georgia’s Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger is preparing to purge the voter registrations of nearly half a million voters, and he’s backed by Georgia Republicans and MAGA extremists. They’re claiming that this is “routine maintenance”; but this purge is using bad data so we know it is likely wrongfully removing many people from the voter rolls. Previous voter purges in Georgia have removed thousands of eligible voters, and historically, we’ve seen purges disproportionately impact Black and brown voters. This one is no different. Team, let’s be honest here: Purges are a form of both voter suppression and voter intimidation. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- As Fair Fight Founder Stacey Abrams puts it: "Many of us grew up with the stories of the civil rights movement and voter suppression of the '60s, guns and dogs and hoses...The voter suppression in the 21st century is administrative." This is exactly what’s happening right now in Georgia. The purge list consists of voters who are registered in Georgia and have been marked as inactive for various reasons — people who may have moved out of Georgia, out-of-state college students, members of the military, or even frequent, long-time Georgia voters who missed out on voting in any recent elections. If a voter has been placed on the inactive list by the Georgia Secretary of State’s office, and does not contact their county office to be reactivated, they will be removed from the voter rolls by August 20th. name: AOC
subject: A 'made-for-TV' cabinet
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Things start tearing apart at the seams.
#
This is exactly what was the risk with Donald Trump: him choosing to appoint charlatans to the head of every agency because he thinks that a ‘made-for-TV’ cabinet is what is good for this country.
What you actually need is a Secretary of Veterans Affairs — and folks who are running the VA — who _actually_ know what they’re doing.
Not what’s just playing well on Fox News and who’s got the best hair gel.
When you invite other charlatans like Elon Musk and DOGE, this is exactly the kind of stuff that happens: **things start breaking and tearing apart at the seams**.
And that starts having rippling effects.
The Big, Ugly Bill cuts the recipients of secondary education — people who want to go to medical school and law school with their Pell grants — when we need a nation that is highly educated to be globally competitive.
We don’t have to just sit back and watch as the President and his billionaire donors turn the country into their personal slush fund — the fact is, **that’s what they want**.
We are not powerless in this moment. But we will have to push harder than ever these next four years for our progressive movement to stand a chance.

**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich.**I’ve had enough.**

**These are no ordinary times, Peter.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong._ Something has to give.
There’s another path, Peter. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we expanded Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.

subject: Grassroots movements are built from the ground up — not the top down
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
This is what it will take to build a better future. Are you in?
#
Here’s the truth about real grassroots movements, Peter:

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Since October 2023, the Israeli government has severely restricted the
amount of food, water, medical supplies, and other aid allowed to enter
Gaza.

As a result, the people of Gaza are starving — they have been for months
on end, and it’s getting so bad that the mainstream media and Democratic
establishment are finally paying attention.

This man-made famine is worsening by the day, with the World Health
Organization reporting that 1 in 5 children under the age of five years
old in Gaza are malnourished.

[2]Tweet by World Health Organization: Malnutrition is on a dangerous
trajectory in the Gaza Strip, marked by a spike in deaths in July. Of 74
malnutrition-related deaths in 2025, 63 occurred in July—including 24
children under five, a child over five, and 38 adults. Most of these
people were declared dead on arrival at health facilities or died shortly
after, their bodies showing clear signs of severe wasting. The crisis
remains entirely preventable. Deliberate blocking and delay of large-scale
food, health, and humanitarian aid has cost many lives. Nearly one in five
children under five in #Gaza City is now acutely malnourished, as reported
by Nutrition Cluster partners. Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM), which
measures the percentage of children aged 6–59 months suffering from acute
malnutrition, has tripled since June, making it the worst-hit area in the
Gaza Strip.

With each day that passes, more Palestinians are dying of starvation, and
Israeli forces are continuing to shoot and kill hundreds of hungry
Palestinians seeking aid. We’re watching the final stages of a genocide
unfold before our eyes.

[3]Al Jazeera Live Updates: Israel kills more than 60 in Gaza as
starvation outrage rises. Israeli forces open fired on Palestinians
waiting for food at sites in Gaza, killing at least 26 and wounding many
others, with more than 60 dying in attacks since dawn.

As we keep building public pressure on U.S. leaders to take action to end
the blockade and stop Israel’s war crimes in Gaza, you can help provide
meals to hungry people in Gaza today.

After a five-day pause due to a lack of supplies, limited cooking
operations at World Central Kitchen’s Deir al-Balah Field Kitchen have
resumed this week.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250728-wck?refcode=em20250728-36885&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36885_1203867_qaJvAF&akid=36885%2E1203867%2EqaJvAF ]Please consider making a donation to World Central Kitchen to support
their ongoing efforts to feed Palestinians on the ground in Gaza. Every
donation makes a difference →

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250728-wck?refcode=em20250728-36885&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36885_1203867_qaJvAF&akid=36885%2E1203867%2EqaJvAF ]Donate

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Hey folks,
Just wrapped a live session with Isaiah Martin--and trust me, this one's a must-watch. Isaiah was _just_ released after being arrested by Texas Republicans, and he's not pulling any punches. We talked gerrymandering, the resistance, and the future of the Democratic Party--and Isaiah is the real deal. Don't miss this.
Here's what went down:
* **[00:01:30] From jail to Congress?** Isaiah recounts the surreal moment of being arrested after testifying at a Texas redistricting hearing.
* **[00:07:08] Jailhouse town hall.** Hear how Isaiah turned his time behind bars into a spontaneous political Q&A with fellow inmates--covering tariffs, voting rights, and how government actually works.
* **[00:12:02] Walks free, doesn 't flinch.** After 30+ hours in jail, Isaiah heads _straight_ to another redistricting hearing to look his political opponents in the eye. What he said to them is electric.
* **[00:20:00] Making America affordable again.** Isaiah lays out his kitchen-table economic agenda--guaranteed health care, child care, student loan relief, forgiving medical debt, and a side hustle fund to jumpstart small businesses.
* **[00:33:00] Ambulances, bills, and broken promises.** I share a personal story about my recent $5,000 ER bill--and we dig deep into why no one should be choosing between medical care and financial ruin in the richest country on Earth.

#
Thank you all for your unwavering support during my previous U.S. Senate race. Your encouragement, trust, and dedication meant the world to me and helped us make a meaningful impact. While that chapter has closed, I remain grateful for each of you and inspired by your commitment to our shared values. Your support encourages me to continue working toward a stronger, more transparent Georgia. Having traveled across Georgia and heard from people in every corner of our state, one thing is clear: Georgians care deeply about election integrity and a fair, transparent process. So do I! That is why I threw my name on the ballot to become your next Secretary of State. I’m a proud Air Force veteran, a dedicated businessman, husband, father, and a proud native of Georgia. I’ve spent my life serving this country, and I’m committed to serving you by ensuring that our election system is secure, fair, and trustworthy. From advocating for better resources for election teams to fighting against outdated voter rolls and unprofessional conduct, I’m working tirelessly to restore confidence in our election process. I can't do it alone. Many of you have been in this fight with me, and no matter where you stand in the debate, we can all agree that a "little" fraud in our elections is too much. Today, I’m reaching out to previous supporters of my U.S. Senate run—and to others who share our values. We need your help to continue this fight. Even small donations make a big difference. Join us as we build a movement focused on honesty, integrity, and effective leadership.

_**Support the cause today**_ —because Georgia deserves a system that works for everyone.
